# Senior Office Assistant

Sacramento County

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/8906886054042140316?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-4191212179322979188&crId=US_0US_0)

The Position This is a continuous filing exam. Next filing cut-offs are at 5:00 pm on:
10/9/2026, 10/30/2026 (final)
Senior Office Assistants provide a wide range of clerical/operational support involving customer service, document preparation, filing, record keeping, and other regularly performed duties which support the function of an office operation. Some Senior Office Assistants may give direction and review the work of a group of workers while performing the same duties as the workers.
Some positions may be designated "confidential" in nature, in accordance with the County Employee Relations Ordinance, and are excluded from the representation unit which includes positions allocated to the regular class.
The Position This is a continuous filing exam. Next filing cut-offs are at 5:00 pm on:
10/9/2026, 10/30/2026 (final)
Senior Office Assistants provide a wide range of clerical/operational support involving customer service, document preparation, filing, record keeping, and other regularly performed duties which support the function of an office operation. Some Senior Office Assistants may give direction and review the work of a group of workers while performing the same duties as the workers.
Some positions may be designated "confidential" in nature, in accordance with the County Employee Relations Ordinance, and are excluded from the representation unit which includes positions allocated to the regular class.
Examples Of Knowledge And Abilities Knowledge of Clear writing: grammar, punctuation, spelling, vocabulary
Standard methods of filing (alphabetic, numeric, chronological)
English language to communicate
Telephone procedures
Arithmetic to make calculations including addition, subtraction, multiplication, division and correct change
Keyboard (computer, typewriter)
Letter and memo format
General principles, procedures and practices of recordkeeping
Customer service techniques
Sacramento County and various departmental policies, procedures and functions
Word processing and applicable terminology
Ability to Calculate solutions to math problems involving addition, subtraction, division and multiplication
Understand and follow basic and complex oral and written instructions
Operate computer terminals, typewriter, printer, copier, microfiche, and FAX
Prioritize work to meet deadlines
Write English at a level necessary to prepare correspondence according to specified format and record incoming information
Speak English at a level necessary to communicate information clearly
Operate communication devices, telephone and may include radios
Accurately proofread details, noting and detecting errors
Communicate effectively with the public and other public agencies
Explain or clarify policies and procedures
Deal tactfully with people and resolve difficult complaints
Read English at a level necessary to understand procedure manuals, policy guidelines, software manuals, technical documents and reports
Write English at a level necessary to compose correspondence independently from notes or verbal instruction
Assists supervisors in writing policies, procedures, and desk manuals
Train and cross-train employees
Give instructions and assign work to staff
Work independently and carry out assignments with minimal supervision
Compile, arrange, and present information in a clear and concise manner
Exercise independent judgment in determining proper work methods and procedures, assembling and evaluating information
Take responsibility and use good judgment in recognizing which decisions to make on your own versus those you should first refer to your supervisor
Establish and maintain effective working relationships with others
Required For Some Positions Types from clear copy accurately at a rate of not less than 45 net words per minute.
Employment Qualifications Minimum Qualification Two (2) years of clerical experience
Note: If the word “experience” is referenced in the minimum qualifications, it means full-time paid experience unless the minimum qualification states that volunteer experience is acceptable. Part-time paid experience may be accumulated and pro-rated to meet the total experience requirements.
Note: If the minimum qualifications include an educational or certificate/license requirement, applicants must submit proof of requirements with the application. Failure to submit proof of requirements may result in disqualification from the examination. Unofficial transcripts are acceptable.
Special Requirements Ability to speak, read, and/or write fluently in a language other than English, or knowledge of the culture as certified by the Department of Personnel Services (formerly the Department of Human Resources).
Gives information by telephone or in person, regarding department services in an language other than English, to persons who understanding of English is limited.
Translates the meaning of written English in regulations or ordinances, to a language other than English.
Translates into English requests from the public, presented orally or in writing in a language other than standard English.
As assigned, assists other department employees by giving information and advice on problems involving relationships with persons of different language or cultural backgrounds.
Probationary Period The probationary period for this classification is six (6) months .
Sacramento County is about enriching communities to thrive. We strive to create inclusive workplaces that reflect the communities we serve. We value and celebrate the unique perspectives, backgrounds, abilities, and diverse dimensions of our employees and residents. Through transparency, courage, innovation, and trust we are committed to advance equity and transformational change.
We are a proud equal opportunity employer.

Arrowhead Professional, a strategic group of professional lines businesses across the Arrowhead Programs platform, is looking for a creative, organized, and delivery-focused marketing professional to lead go-to-market efforts across its specialty insurance offerings. # Senior Scheduler

$165k - $200k

Dome Construction Corporation

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/4533826347035861340?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=258&jdpSource=101&jdpid=4139791151569652529&crId=US_0US_0)

### Job Description

Job Description

Senior SchedulerShape the Strategy Behind Dome's Most Complex Projects

At Dome Construction, a strong schedule is more than a project requirement. It is a strategic tool that helps teams anticipate challenges, make informed decisions, and deliver with greater predictability.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Scheduler to provide advanced planning and scheduling leadership for Dome's largest, most complex, and highest-risk projects. In this highly collaborative role, you will develop comprehensive project schedules, identify material risks and constraints, and translate complex scheduling information into clear, practical recommendations.

As a technical subject-matter expert, you will partner with Operations, Project Management, Field Operations, Preconstruction, BIM/VDC, trade partners, and clients. You will help align planning assumptions, procurement, coordination milestones, field execution, and critical project commitments while strengthening scheduling knowledge across the organization.

If you are a strategic construction professional who enjoys solving complex problems, influencing project outcomes, and helping teams plan with confidence, this could be the right next step for you.

What You'll DoLead Planning for Complex Projects

- Lead the development of proposal, preconstruction, baseline, master, milestone, and recovery schedules for large, complex, high-risk, or multiphase projects
- Establish schedule architecture, calendars, coding structures, work breakdown structures, logic, milestones, and reporting methods
- Guide teams through planning for design, permitting, procurement, logistics, construction, startup, testing, commissioning, inspections, turnover, and closeout
- Support pursuit strategy, feasibility analysis, schedule narratives, and client presentations
- Partner with BIM/VDC to incorporate coordination, fabrication, and model-deliverable milestones into the overall project schedule

Turn Schedule Data into Action

- Analyze critical and near-critical paths, float trends, milestones, productivity assumptions, and completion forecasts
- Identify significant constraints, conflicts, and potential delays before they materially affect project outcomes
- Lead mitigation and recovery planning through what-if analysis, resequencing, acceleration options, contingency planning, and time-impact analysis
- Partner with project leadership when schedule conditions may create contractual, financial, client, or reputational exposure

Strengthen Project Predictability

- Oversee schedule updates and validate actual progress, remaining durations, logic changes, milestone dates, and completion forecasts
- Review schedules across multiple projects for technical quality, consistency, contract compliance, and alignment with Dome standards
- Conduct schedule-health reviews and verify alignment between the CPM schedule, collaborative planning commitments, procurement and submittal logs, BIM/VDC milestones, and field execution plans

Facilitate, Influence, and Mentor

- Lead schedule-review meetings, pull-planning and phase-planning sessions, recovery workshops, and executive schedule reviews
- Present clear forecasts, risks, options, and recommendations to project teams, clients, Operations, and senior leadership
- Mentor Schedulers and coach Project Managers, Superintendents, Estimators, and other team members on CPM fundamentals and collaborative planning
- Review the work of less-experienced schedulers and provide practical, constructive technical guidance

Improve How We Plan

- Develop dashboards, graphics, schedule narratives, variance reports, milestone summaries, and executive forecasts
- Help establish and maintain Dome's scheduling standards, templates, quality checks, coding structures, and reporting expectations
- Lead or participate in post-project schedule reviews and turn lessons learned into practical improvements
- Create reusable job aids, examples, and training resources
- Evaluate emerging scheduling methods and technologies in partnership with Operations, Field Operations, Preconstruction, BIM/VDC, and Learning & Development

What You Bring

- Seven or more years of experience in construction scheduling, project controls, field operations, project management, or a related area
- Demonstrated success developing and managing schedules for large, complex, high-risk, or technically challenging commercial construction projects
- Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6
- Experience with baseline development, schedule updates, critical-path analysis, recovery planning, time-impact analysis, and executive schedule reporting
- The ability to read and interpret drawings, specifications, contracts, and project requirements
- The confidence and communication skills to lead planning discussions with project teams, trade partners, clients, and senior leaders
- A bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant construction scheduling experience

Even Better If You Have

- Advanced training in project controls, scheduling, Lean construction, or construction planning
- A Planning & Scheduling Professional certification or comparable credential
- Experience overseeing multiple projects simultaneously
- Experience facilitating pull-planning, phase-planning, milestone-planning, recovery, and executive schedule-review sessions
- Experience mentoring schedulers or building scheduling knowledge within project teams
- Experience with healthcare, life sciences, advanced technology, tenant improvement, ground-up, or other highly phased projects
- Working knowledge of resource or cost loading, crew logic, Takt or location-based planning, schedule risk analysis, and visual or 4D planning tools

How You'll Make an Impact

Your expertise will help teams see challenges earlier, evaluate options more clearly, and build realistic paths forward. You will bring structure to complex project conditions, improve the quality of schedule-driven decisions, and help strengthen planning and scheduling practices across Dome.

Although this role does not have direct supervisory responsibilities, the Senior Scheduler is expected to mentor less-experienced schedulers, review their work, and provide technical guidance to project teams.

This position also includes occasional travel to construction sites, Dome office locations, client meetings, planning sessions, training events, and other business-related meetings. Travel will vary based on project assignments, locations, and business needs.

Ready to Help Build What's Next?

If you see scheduling as a strategic discipline and enjoy helping teams turn complex project conditions into clear, achievable plans, we would love to hear from you.

**Join Dome Construction and help shape the planning strategies behind our most complex projects.**

# Sr. Accounts Payable Specialist - Battery Storage

Plus Power

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/8151328793979663117?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-147134999868648279&crId=US_0US_0)

## Senior Accounts Payable Specialist

Plus Power recruits outstanding energy industry professionals who are driven to develop, build and operate assets safely and reliably while growing their careers. Our team looks for data-driven and fact-based mindsets, engaging and collaborative behaviors, and personal growth-focused professionals.

We are looking to hire a Senior Accounts Payable Specialist to join the company's accounting team. The ideal candidate will have prior renewable, development, or construction experience and the ability to take the initiative in completing tasks in a time-sensitive and high-quality manner. This role includes significant responsibilities and room for growth within the company.

### Key Responsibilities

- Process high volumes of A/P invoices through Stampli across multiple related legal entities, ensuring proper entity allocation, approvals, supporting documentation, general ledger coding, data entry, and payment processing; identify and resolve vendor account discrepancies
- Periodically compare vendor terms with activity to ensure the most cost- and time- effective payment methods and timing are being used
- Coordinate with vendors and internal teams to obtain and verify W-9s and payment instructions, including ACH, wire and BillPay information, and complete required phone verification of vendor banking details
- Set up and maintain new vendors in NetSuite and applicable banking platforms, ensuring accurate and complete vendor information
- Process company credit card transactions through Stampli, ensuring appropriate supporting documentation and general ledger coding
- Manage the annual 1099 reporting and filing process, ensuring accurate and timely completion.
- Assist with compliance issues related to accounts payable processes (W-9, sales and use tax, etc.)
- Serve as a liaison between Plus Power and more than 300 vendors, addressing billing, payment, and account-related inquiries and issues
- Review project-related expenses for appropriate approval and work closely with project management teams to process invoices and ensure timely payment
- Update, verify and maintain accounting journals, ledgers and other financial records, ensuring accuracy and compliance with project contract accounting requirements and internal controls
- Assist with producing periodic financial reports and ensure reported results are accurate and comply with U.S. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP).
- Support the management of external relationships, as requested, including accounting firms, banking partners, investors, insurance brokers and bonding agents
- Prepare accounts payable-journal entries, ensure accurate general ledger coding and support the monthly close process
- Reconcile the accounts payable ledger to ensure that all bills and payments are accounted for and properly posted
- Generate reports detailing accounts payables status
- Proactively work on initiatives to implement operational accounting efficiencies through process improvements and control enhancements
- Assist with supplying documentation for annual audits, loan draws, etc.
- Support investor reporting, budgeting and forecasting activities, as requested
- Develop, implement and effective and efficient internal controls, policies, procedures and workflows to safeguard company assets and promote accurate financial reporting
- Other projects as assigned

### Skills & Qualifications

- BA/BS in Accounting or Finance
- 4+ years' relevant work experience in an accounting department
- Current experience in renewable energy, power and utilities, or construction preferred
- Expert proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Microsoft Excel along with macro-writing capabilities, pivot tables, and data queries
- Working knowledge and experience with Stampli, NetSuite or similar software
- Strong organization and communication skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail
- High degree of business acumen, discretion, and professionalism
- Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with vendors, colleagues and internal stakeholders
- Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively and effectively in a cross-functional environment with team members who are geographically dispersed
- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while remaining aligned with company and department objectives
- Proven ability to stay connected and maintain communication across distributed teams in hybrid or remote settings
- Strong desire and demonstrated ability to learn quickly, take initiative, and assume increasing responsibility
- Ability to effectively manage multiple priorities and deliver timely, high-quality results

### Compensation, Location, and Benefits

Highly competitive total compensation from one of North America's leading energy storage developers, owners, and operators, along with market-leading health benefits, 401(k) match, generous paid parental leave, flexible time off, work from home stipend, and other programs designed to support employees and their families.

Flexible work arrangements include work-from-home or hybrid options from Plus Power's offices in The Woodlands, San Francisco, Chicago, Seattle, Brooklyn, Denver, Palm Beach Gardens, and Birmingham. While we are a remote-first company, we also have a highly engaged and connected culture, with opportunities to come together for in-person connection, professional development, and continued learning and growth.

The expected salary range\* for this position begins at $80,000. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range based on several factors including, but not limited to relevant experience, skills, qualifications, geographic labor market, and other factors consistent with applicable law. This position is also eligible to participate in our annual bonus program.

The deadline\* for applying to this role is 11/15/26.

Plus Power is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds can thrive. Plus Power is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

\*This information is provided in accordance with applicable law.

Pacific Pros

### Job Description

Job Description

**Benefits:**

- 401(k)
- 401(k) matching
- Dental insurance
- Health insurance
- Paid time off
- Vision insurance

Pacific Pros is seeking **Scheduler III** for **Construction Projects** to be a representative for COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES, DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC WORKS.

**Work Location: LAWA has required the candidates be local for this position** .

**Region: Los Angeles, CA**

**Status: Full-time on-site.**

**Opening: Start date will be sometime between April 2026 through July 2026**

**Required Qualifications**

- Minimum of 15 years working in the construction project management field.
- Effective oral and written communication skills.
- Demonstrate positive attitude and excellence in customer service.
- Detail oriented with effective organization and coordination skills.
- Ability to be flexible/adaptable in evolving procedures and work under pressure to meet critical deadlines.
- Proactive in taking initiatives to seek solutions with minimum, vague, and/or conflicting guidelines.
- Experience working in a cohesive team environment.
- Proficient in using Microsoft Office software (Teams, SharePoint, Power BI, Project, Word, Excel, Outlook, OneNote, PowerPoint).
- Experience in working with capital and public works projects.
- Experience in drafting and editing status reports, meeting minutes, memos, and letters.
- Experience in assisting project team to keep management informed on project progress.

**Scope of Work**

- Responsible for analysis and review of construction schedules (baseline/updates) and Time Impact Analysis (TIA) reports
- Prepare the master and detailed time schedules
- Input resources, costs, project budget, performance percent complete for EVM reports, resource assignments, and leveling.
- Utilize Critical Path Method and milestones plan for monitoring deliverables
- Time and cost control for all sub-contracts, sub-suppliers, and stakeholders for the prime contract.
- Prepare cash flow and dedicated charts, progress meeting schedule, daily, weekly, and monthly reports, documents and correspondences, and contracts control and management.
- Monitor project progress against a determined baseline. Prepare analysis for staff and stakeholders and identifying critical paths, near critical paths, milestone impacts, phasing shifts, and potential trends.
- Provide impact analysis of schedule changes, identify schedule variances and opportunities, and develops mitigation plans for the Project Management team.
- Provide reporting documents and briefing materials. Develops creative reporting tools to communicate complex project sequencing and/or progress assessments. Responsible for promptly reporting schedule interruptions or other variances.
- Prepares detailed plans and time scaled charts and diagrams for executive review and presentation.
- Maintain simplified logic schedules to highlight status of key interfaces for critical path review.
- Review design and/or construction schedules and provide written comments, Coordinates schedule comments and corrections with Contractor.
- Advises senior project management team of schedule performance issues.
- Evaluate requests for time extensions. Perform windows analyses and prepare write-ups with executive recommendations for action.
- Develop and maintain detailed construction planning schedules for new construction and renovation work.

# Senior E-Billing Coordinator

$90k - $105k

Latham & Watkins

[Los Angeles, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Los-Angeles%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/1398193095162480022?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6546&pageType=7&jobAge=18&jdpSource=101&jdpid=5632466280373742441&crId=US_0US_0)

**About Latham & Watkins**

Latham & Watkins is one of the world's leading global law firms advising the businesses and institutions that drive the global economy. We are the market leaders in major financial and business centers around the world. Our investment in people, commitment to innovation, and focus on the future empower you to build an incredible career and thrive as an exceptional professional in a supportive culture. If you aspire to be the best, and work with the best, this is where you belong.

**About the Role**

The Senior E-Billing Coordinator is an integral part of Latham's Global Finance team and will be responsible for the submission of electronic invoices to clients on a monthly basis, overseeing the transition of clients to e-billing, and providing follow-up support to attorneys, practice office staff, and clients in all aspects related to electronic billing, as well as handling a heavy volume of highly complex e-submission assignments for key corporate clients and ensuring that all client guidelines, internal protocols, and firm guidelines are followed during the submission process. This role will be located in either our Global Satellite Office in Downtown Los Angeles, San Diego, Silicon Valley, San Francisco, or Orange County office. Please note that this role may be eligible for a flexible working schedule that allows for a hybrid and in-office presence.

**Responsibilities & Qualifications**

Other key responsibilities include:

- Acting as a liaison between billing attorney/secretarial staff, practice office billing staff, and clients' staff assigned to electronic billing by providing expert-level subject matter support
- Liaising with billing attorney/secretary, practice office accounting staff, and client representatives in the resubmission of invoices and ensuring corrective action is in place for future submissions
- Populating, maintaining, and updating data for assigned clients in the 3E system and clients' external web applications, while also ensuring all relevant information is updated and correlated in the firm's 3E system
- Performing necessary technical and logistical tasks with internal staff, vendor staff, and clients' designated personnel in the transition of clients to electronic billing
- Working collaboratively with the department's supervisor to support e-billing systems by adding/removing user accounts, resetting passwords, assigning proper security levels, entering budgets, status reports, and matter profiles in various sub-systems
- Protecting and maintaining any highly sensitive, confidential, privileged, financial, and/or proprietary information that Latham & Watkins retains

We'd love to hear from you if you:

- Possess knowledge and experience with web-based e-billing systems and vendors (e.g., Serengeti, Datacert, Tymetrix)
- Demonstrate the ability to test and troubleshoot multiple e-software applications, summarize findings, and identify potential problem areas
- Display the ability to work with LEDES formats

And have:

- A high school diploma or equivalent, preferably a bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or another related field
- A minimum of two (2) years of experience with the 3E Billing system
- A minimum of two (2) years of experience with E-billing vendors
- A minimum of five (5) years of experience involving general accounting practices
- A minimum of four (4) years of experience involving billing processes and practices
- Knowledge of 3E's E-Invoicing module, preferably

**Benefits & Additional Information**

Successful candidates will not only be provided with an outstanding career opportunity and welcoming environment, but will also be provided with a generous total compensation package with bonuses awarded in recognition of both individual and firm performance. Eligible employees can participate in Latham's comprehensive benefit program which includes:

- Healthcare, life and disability insurance
- A generous 401k plan
- At least 11 paid holidays per year, and a PTO program that accrues 23 days during the first year of employment and grows with tenure
- Well-being programs (e.g. mental health services, mindfulness and resiliency, medical resources, well-being events, and more)
- Professional development programs
- Employee discounts
- Affinity groups, networks, and coalitions for lawyers and staff

Latham & Watkins is an equal opportunity employer. The Firm prohibits discrimination against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race (including, but not limited to, hair texture and protective hairstyles), color, religion, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status (including veterans of the Vietnam era), gender expression, marital status, or any other characteristic or condition protected by applicable statute.

Job Summary

Analyzes and defines direct material requirements, coordinating with the purchasing team to ensure efficient and timely delivery of materials to support production. \| Collaborates with engineering to identify material needs for customer return merchandise authorizations (RMAs) and manages the execution of RMA shop orders. \| Develops direct material forecasts to support site revenue planning and program profitability analysis. \| May serve as a backup to other team members in production planning.

Impact of the Role

General ProfileRequires in-depth conceptual and practical knowledge in own job discipline and basic knowledge of related job disciplines Solves complex problems Works independently, receives minimal guidanceMay lead projects or project steps within a broader project or may have accountability for on-going activities or objectives Acts as a resource for colleagues with less experienceConsistent exercise of discretion & judgment

Essential Functions

Provides support by planning and tracking material needed for production schedules. Monitors inventory levels and coordinates with purchasing to maintain adequate levels of parts and raw materials to manufacture products. Works to resolve and takes corrective action for materials issues impacting production schedules while achieving and maintaining inventory business metrics. Analyze, plan, schedule, and initiate procurement actions. Ensures materials are cost effective. Assists in determining and ensuring the quality of materials. Execute material that required outside processing.

PROGRAM SUMMARYKBR’s Government Asset Management (GAM) organization safeguards U.S. Government property and supports engineering, procurement, production, IT, and program teams across aerospace and defense programs. This DoD SkillBridge internship is for transitioning service members within 180 days of separation (with commander approval). # Sr. Bookkeeper (Wilbraham)

Location:Wilbraham, MACompany:Maeva Dental Advisors

## Description:

**Company Description** Maeva Dental Advisors supports dental practices with specialized advisory and financial services designed to improve operational performance and long-term stability. The organization focuses on practical, data-driven solutions that help providers manage growth, streamline operations, and strengthen financial health. Team members collaborate closely with practice owners and managers to address both day-to-day challenges and strategic initiatives. Joining Maeva Dental Advisors offers the opportunity to work within a focused, professional environment that values accuracy, reliability, and client-centered service.

**Role Description** The Sr. Bookkeeper role at Maeva Dental Advisors is a full-time, Hybrid position based in Wilbraham, MA. This role is responsible for managing day-to-day bookkeeping activities for dental practices, including recording transactions, posting journal entries, and maintaining accurate general ledgers. The Sr. Bookkeeper prepares and reviews financial statements, reconciles bank and credit card accounts, and monitors accounts payable and receivable. The position includes working with accounting software (QBO and Bill.com) to generate reports, support month-end and year-end closing, and provide clear financial documentation for advisory and tax purposes. The Sr. Bookkeeper collaborates with practice leadership and internal team members to ensure compliant, timely, and reliable financial records.

**Qualifications**

- Strong proficiency in Bookkeeping and Finance, with experience managing day-to-day transactional accounting for small or mid-sized businesses.
- Ability to spot workflow optimization opportunities and identify process efficiencies using AI and other analytical software
- Ability to prepare, analyze, and interpret Financial Statements to support decision-making and advisory recommendations.
- Hands-on experience with Accounting Software and accurate posting of Journal Entries (Accounting) in a structured general ledger environment.
- Solid understanding of basic accounting principles, reconciliations, and cash flow tracking.
- High attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and ability to manage multiple clients or entities simultaneously.
- Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain financial information to non-financial stakeholders.
- Experience in healthcare or dental practice accounting is preferred but not required.
- Relevant education such as an associate or bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

# Talent Partnerships Senior Account Coordinator (Chicago)

Location:Schiller Park, ILCompany:Later

## Description:

Later is the world’s most intelligent influencer marketing company, built to give brands the confidence to create unforgettable campaigns. By combining real creator relationships, trusted intelligence, and expert guidance, Later removes fear and guesswork from one of marketing’s most visible investments.

Built on a native, AI-powered platform and more than a decade of proprietary data—including billions of social interactions, impressions, and $2.4B+ in verified influencer-driven purchases—Later helps teams understand what will work before they launch.

By combining trusted insight with expert guidance, Later removes guesswork from influencer marketing, enabling brands to choose the right creators, execute fully managed campaigns, and drive meaningful growth across awareness, engagement, and revenue. Trusted by leading enterprise brands including Nike, Wayfair, Unilever, and Southwest Airlines, Later bridges creativity and performance so campaigns don’t just look good—they deliver results. Learn more at later.com.

**Senior Coordinator, Talent Partnerships** **About the role:** As **Sr Coordinator, Talent Partnerships**, you will own and evolve how Later identifies, engages, and activates influencer talent across high-impact influencer marketing campaigns. You’ll be responsible for building a best-in-class talent ecosystem—one that gives our clients access to the right creators faster, unlocks premium partnerships, and differentiates Later.

This is both a strategic and executional role. You’ll shape our point of view on talent—who matters, why they matter, and how brands should work with them—while also leading the day-to-day sourcing, negotiation, and relationship management that brings campaigns to life. You will bring to Later your vast and diverse relationships with agencies, ensuring our clients gain access to premium talent while driving efficiencies and impact across campaigns.

You’ll partner closely with Strategy and Client Services to ensure talent is not an afterthought, but a core lever in every program we execute. At the same time, you’ll cultivate deep relationships across the creator and management landscape, positioning Later as a preferred partner for high-value talent and their representatives.

**What you'll do:** **Strategy**

- Develops and continuously refines Later’s point of view on creator talent across categories, platforms, and cultural trends.
- Identifies emerging and high-impact creators aligned to client objectives and brand positioning.
- Stays ahead of industry shifts, pricing trends, and platform dynamics to inform recommendations.
- Assists in refining processes and best practices, ensuring campaigns align with industry trends and customer goals.
- Proactively surfaces agile talent and culture-driven strategic opportunities, pitching to the appropriate parties in alignment with customer business needs.


**Technical/ Execution**

- Sources and secures creator talent for campaigns, balancing quality, speed, and strategic fit.
- Embed yourself within the account pod as a creator procurement expert, with a deep understanding of your client’s brand archetype, ideal talent personas, and vetting requirements.
- Builds and maintains strong relationships with creators, agents, and managers to unlock priority access to talent.
- Leads sourcing, negotiations, and contracting for all tiers of talent, ensuring talent and agreements meet client strategy, brand safety, and compliance standards.
- Continuously improves workflows and processes to increase scalability and efficiency in talent sourcing and trend identification.
- Organizes recurring touch bases with talent representatives to unlock access for the Customer Team to major talent relationships and milestones.


**Team / Collaboration**

- Partners with cross functional teams including Services, Product, Strategy, Research, and Creator teams, to embed a creator and culture-first approach is at the forefront of everything we are building across the org.
- Partners with cross functional teams to ensure a seamless campaign execution and service evolution.
- Contributes to client conversations with a strong, informed POV on talent recommendations.


**Leadership**

- Acts as the internal expert on creator talent, when working with internal teams. Advise on best practices when working with different tiers or types of talent.
- Builds and strengthen Later’s reputation within the talent ecosystem through consistent, high-quality partnerships.
- Champions operational excellence and hold a high bar for performance across the Services team.


**Research/Best Practices**

- Stays ahead of platform shifts, monetization models, and compliance regulations (FTC, platform-specific rules).
- Has a deep understanding of the regulations and requirements of clients in highly-regulated industries to ensure compliance as a core standard to every step of your work.
- Continuously benchmarks industry best practices and apply insights to evolve Later’s talent partnership approach.
- Experiments with new systems, processes, and partnership models to test-and-learn at scale.


**What success looks like:**

- Upholds high operational excellence, leading the organization of ongoing casting and trend-identification efforts.
- Builds and maintains a differentiated network of creators and representatives that provides a competitive advantage.
- Drives measurable impact on campaign success, client retention, and revenue growth.
- Consistently identifies and secures high-impact creator talent that elevates campaign performance and client outcomes.
- You excel at balancing campaign management, relationship management, and the creation and maintenance of operational workflows.
- The cross functional team and customers view you as a trusted advisor on talent, who serves as a go to across verticals of talent and different types of talent integrations.
- Establishes Later as a preferred partner for top-tier talent and their teams.


**What you bring:**

- 2-3 years of experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, or talent management, with a proven track record of building and scaling high-impact creator programs; agency background preferred.
- Demonstrated success in sourcing, negotiating, and managing influencer relationships across all tiers of influencers, and across various partnership models.
- Experience casting talent for brands that sit highly regulated industries.
- Strong network of creator, agent, and manager relationships across key verticals and platforms.
- Strong strategic and analytical skills with experience managing scalable systems that improve efficiency and outcomes.
- Deep understanding of social platforms, creator economics, and cultural trends.
- Experience implementing AI and workflow to increase operational efficiencies.
- Exceptional negotiation and relationship management skills, with the ability to cultivate trust and secure competitive agreements.
- Experience collaborating cross-functionally with cross-departmental teams.
- Strong understanding of FTC guidelines, brand safety standards, and compliance requirements.
- Familiarity with influencer marketing platforms, CRM systems, and campaign analytics tools.
- An entrepreneurial mindset—operationally excellent, solutions-oriented, and energized by scaling complex systems in a fast-paced environment.
- Clear communicator with strong judgment and attention to detail, with experience representing an organization externally.


**How you work:**

- **Driven by Impact:** You deliver results that matter—prioritizing high-value work, meeting deadlines, and adapting quickly while keeping outcomes clear.
- **Strategic & Customer-Centric:** You anticipate risks and opportunities, connect decisions to long-term growth, and build trust through proactive insights.
- **Curious & Growth-Oriented:** You seek knowledge, ask sharp questions, and apply learnings fast—challenging the status quo with a mindset of improvement.
- **Collaborative & Resilient:** You thrive in change by staying resourceful, solution-focused, and positive—removing roadblocks, sharing insights, and keeping morale high.
- **Accountable & Honest:** You own your work, hold yourself and others to a high bar, and use transparent feedback to drive growth.
- **Emotionally Intelligent:** You build trust through empathy and collaboration, foster inclusion, and inspire others with grit, optimism, and integrity.

# Sr. Construction Bookkeeper (Boynton Beach)

Location:Ocean Ridge, FLCompany:CareerSource Palm Beach County

## Description:

**About the Company**

Our employer is a luxury construction and remodeling company serving Palm Beach County,specializing in high-end renovations, custom projects, and new construction.

**About the Role**

They are in search of a Sr. Construction Bookkeeper to manage the day-to-day financial and accounting functions of their construction projects. Responsibilities include processing invoices and payments, payroll preparation, account reconciliation, job-cost tracking, monitoring project expense and budgets, maintaining accurate financial records, and preparing financial reports. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and experienced in bookkeeping or accounting. Construction industry and job-costing experience is required. This position works closely with project managers and leadership to maintain accurate financial reporting and help keep projects within budget.

**Responsibilities**

- Maintain accurate, up-to-date financial records and enter transactions in QuickBooks Online, assigning expenses to the appropriate project and cost category.
- Process accounts payable and receivable, including vendor invoices, subcontractor payment requests, client billing, and collections.
- Communicate professionally with customers, vendors, and subcontractors to verify charges, clarify payment details, and resolve discrepancies.
- Review transactions and supporting documentation for accuracy, proper approvals, and duplicate entries.
- Track project budgets, actual costs, purchase orders, subcontract commitments, and approved change orders; identify and report potential cost overruns.
- Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and relevant balance-sheet accounts monthly.
- Process payroll, review timekeeping records, and allocate labor costs accurately across projects.
- Support month-end close and prepare financial statements, job-cost reports, and budget-versus-actual summaries for leadership review.
- Monitor outstanding receivables, upcoming payment obligations, client deposits, and retainage where applicable.
- Maintain vendor and subcontractor documentation, including W-9s, certificates of insurance, and required lien waivers and releases.
- Stay current on construction accounting practices, payroll requirements, and lien waiver procedures relevant to the role.
- Help develop and maintain accounting procedures and internal controls in coordination with leadership and the outside CPA.
- Prepare supporting records for year-end reporting, 1099 preparation, tax filings, and CPA review.
- Work closely with project managers and leadership to resolve accounting issues and improve the accuracy and timeliness of financial reporting.

**Qualifications**

- Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, or a related field
- Minimum of 2 years of previous experience as an accountant, bookkeeper, or similar position; **must have experience in the construction industry**
- Knowledge of generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP)
- Good with spreadsheets, experienced in Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks, and basic accounting systems
- Strong mathematical and analytical skills
- Excellent attention to detail, time management, and communication skills
- Bilingual is a plus
- Experience using Buildertrend Construction online software a huge plus!

# Senior Product Marketing Manager

Location:Miami, FLCompany:Sauce

## Description:

Job DescriptionJob Description Sauce is a premier restaurant technology platform that helps businesses grow with our Commission-Free Delivery & Pickup structure and proprietary delivery optimization technology. We are serving a 105 billion dollar US local restaurant business. Headquartered in NYC and Tel-Aviv, Sauce wants restaurants to fulfill their highest potential, this means giving local establishments everything they need to connect directly with their customers. The Sauce team pools together decades of restaurant tech experience, along with seasoned tech, sales, marketing, product and operations executives who produce an industry-changing delivery system for successful local restaurants and chains. What You’ll Do:

- **Define and sharpen all external and internal messaging**, translating multi-featured product capabilities into clear, compelling narratives for specific solutions and use cases.

- **Create core PMM assets yourself** (web pages, sales/CS decks, battle cards) with consistent messaging across all GTM channels (Marketing, Sales-Enablement, Customer Success), adapting narratives for different audiences and phases of the user journey.

- **New Product Campaigns:** Plan and execute end-to-end launches and product updates, coordinating cross-functionally to deliver positioning, messaging, and campaign assets.

- **Research turned into actionable insights:** Conduct user research to uncover workflows and pain points, translating insights into actionable direction for the marketing, sales, success and product teams.

- **Support Product-Led Growth initiatives:** that drive discovery, sales, onboarding, and cross-sell through in-product experiences and funnel optimization.


What You Bring:

- 5+ years of product marketing experience in B2SMB; Experience in the US QSR restaurant industry or delivery marketplaces - Must.

- You've owned a core product area end-to-end: from ICP and positioning through to launches and field enablement.

- You've worked in fast-moving environments where the product ships faster than the messaging can keep up - and found a way to move at that pace without losing quality.

- A systems thinker who builds messaging architectures and frameworks others can use, not just one-off assets.

- Proven track record to craft clear, differentiated messaging that resonates to non-technical audiences.

- Excellent written communication and strong editorial judgment, with a proven ability to craft clear, differentiated messaging that resonates with non-technical audiences, while actively pushing for specificity and alignment.

- Data-driven approach: Comfortable conducting user interviews and synthesizing qualitative and quantitative insights into actionable marketing and product direction, using metrics and funnel analysis.

- Comfortable working closely with product, R&D, growth, design, and marketing teams in a fast-moving environment.

- Self-starter mindset: A proactive, independent contributor who thrives in fast-paced environments and can move quickly from strategy to execution.

- AI-first mindset: comfortable using AI tools to automate and scale workflows, with a natural inclination toward AI-native approaches in day-to-day work.

- Ambitious and competitive: you set a high bar, think big, and want to win. You'll go the extra mile and you're motivated by building something that leads the market.


What We Offer:

- Strong & Competitive Compensation Package, Including Equity
- Company-Sponsored Insurance Package (Health, Dental, Vision, Mental Health)
- Paid Parental Leave
- Flexible Work Environment
- Responsible Paid Time Off Policy

## BRENTWOOD SCHOOL

Executive Assistant to the Executive Director of Advancement

Brentwood School, a vibrant and diverse K-12 independent school, is looking for an Executive Assistant to the Executive Director of Advancement to start as soon as possible. Philanthropy background in healthcare or higher education is a plus. This is a non-exempt, full-time, 12-month position with occasional evening and weekend work required.

**Position Summary:**
Under the direction of the Executive Director of Advancement, the Executive Assistant (EA) will support the Executive Director of Advancement and other members of the Advancement team as needed. In addition to general office and administrative responsibilities, the EA will create event and donor briefings, produce reports, interact with donors and prospects and participate in planning and execution of events in addition to other duties assigned. A strategic problem-solver with sound judgment and a collaborative style will thrive in our close knit, professional, and productive team.

Duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
Fundraising Operations

Collaborates with Constituent Database Manager to organize and oversee all prospect research

Assists with donor and prospect management database and related systems

Create briefings for events and individual meetings.

Supports the tracking and reporting on status of fundraising goals

Assists in event planning and execution.

Creates invitations and forms to manage RSVPs, and prepares supporting materials as needed

Administrative Support

Brings joy and a good sense of humor to the workplace

Partners on varied tasks for the Advancement Office, including inventory management and ordering of supplies, occasional mailings, work order submissions, ensuring tidiness of common area and storage spaces, and birthday celebrations.

Processes correspondence, donation documentation, invoices, and check requests

Supports planning, tracking and logistics for major events

Takes, prepares, and shares notes from staff meetings

Assists with additional Advancement functions as requested by Executive Director of Advancement, including occasional evening and weekend events.

Other duties as assigned by Executive Director of Advancement or Senior Administrative Team

**Skills and Qualifications:**

Bachelor's Degree or at least 5 years work experience in an administrative support role, preferably at the executive level

Well-developed interpersonal skills to establish and maintain effective working relationships and interact with individuals from a range of backgrounds

Data-driven and digital first mentality

Fluent in Google Suite, MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint. Adobe Creative Cloud is a plus

CRM experience required (Raiser’s Edge NXT and Research Point preferred)

Talent managing simultaneous projects and deadlines with flexibility and adaptability, while maintaining calm under pressure

Ability to maintain complete confidentiality

Articulate in oral and written communication with excellent proofreading and organizational skills

Ability to work independently and follow through on assignments with minimal direction

Skill in managing a complex calendar, prioritizing well, and resolving conflicts

Other Expectations

Engage in professional and personal development with a consistent commitment to growth

Participate and initiate opportunities that demonstrate one's growth, knowledge, and skills

While being vaccinated for COVID-19 is not required, it is strongly recommended.

## COMPENSATION:

Brentwood School's diverse and talented faculty ranges widely in experience level, from those new to teaching to veterans who are experts in their respective disciplines with 30+ years of experience.

Our salary range, of $68,000 to $75,000, includes all levels of experience. Salaries are determined based on years of experience, education, full- or part-time status, and number of months worked per school year. Salary ranges do not include benefits i.e.

403b retirement matching, paid lunch and various other benefits of being a member of the Brentwood School community.

Memory Care of Contra Costa is currently seeking a Business Office Manager to join our team of dedicated professionals who want to make a difference in the lives of our residents, their families and our community. About the Opportunity The Business Office Manager serves as the primary point of contact for employment opportunities within the community and manages the full recruitment lifecycle, including sourcing candidates, conducting screenings, facilitating interviews, coordinating pre-employment requirements, onboarding new hires, and supporting employee retention initiatives. This position also oversees personnel records, compliance documentation, HRIS and payroll system maintenance, Workday transactions, and employee status changes. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Business Office Administration Maintain current resident records, closed resident files, and required community files in accordance with company policies and regulatory requirements.
Maintain vendor files, contracts, transfer agreements, certificates of insurance, and other community documentation.
Provide administrative and secretarial support to community leadership.
Manage office supply inventory, incoming mail, correspondence, and filing systems.
Maintain legally required labor law and compliance postings.
Answer phones, greet visitors, residents, families, applicants, and vendors in a professional manner.
Maintain effective communication with employees, residents, families, and the public.
Resident Financial Services Orient residents and responsible parties to billing procedures.
Prepare and distribute monthly resident statements.
Maintain accurate daily census information and record admissions, discharges, room rate changes, and notice documentation.
Process accounts payable invoices and supporting documentation.
Maintain petty cash and deposit designated revenues according to company policy.
Support accounts receivable and collections processes.
Provide census and billing information to designated vendors and partners.
Human Resources & Payroll Administration Maintain accurate personnel records and confidential employee files, including required separate files for FMLA, ADA, I-9, Workers' Compensation, and other legally protected records.
Maintain employee information within Workday and other HR/payroll systems.
Process payroll accurately and timely in accordance with company deadlines and policies.
Maintain employee schedules and payroll documentation.
Support compensation changes, status changes, promotions, transfers, supervisor assignments, and other employment transactions.
Generate and maintain HR, payroll, and labor management reports.
Recruitment & Onboarding Serve as the primary point of contact for all community recruitment efforts.
Partner with leadership to identify staffing needs and develop recruitment strategies.
Source candidates through job boards, referrals, community outreach, and recruitment events.
Coordinate job postings and ensure compliance with federal and state posting requirements.
Conduct candidate screenings, interviews, background checks, reference checks, license verifications, drug screenings, and E-Verify processing.
Prepare conditional offers, new hire packets, onboarding documentation, and employee records.
Coordinate new hire orientation, Workday setup, Pennant U LMS enrollment, and time clock enrollment.
Collaborate with department leaders to ensure successful employee onboarding and transition into the workplace.
Employee Relations, Benefits & Leave Administration Support employee engagement, retention, and recognition initiatives.
Maintain seniority dates and employment records.
Administer performance management documentation, including disciplinary actions, corrective actions, performance improvement plans (PIPs), and evaluations.
Coordinate voluntary and involuntary terminations, including documentation, exit processes, final pay requirements, and equipment collection.
Assist employees with benefits enrollment, qualifying life events, and benefits-related inquiries.
Administer leave of absence processes, including FMLA, medical leaves, personal leaves, state-specific leaves, and Sedgwick coordination.
Support unemployment claims, hearings, and documentation requests.
Assist with Workers' Compensation reporting, injury documentation, OSHA logs, and safety-related recordkeeping.
Compliance & Training Maintain compliance with federal, state, and company employment requirements.
Ensure completion and tracking of required employee training, certifications, and continuing education.
Maintain training records through Pennant U LMS and other learning systems.
Support CAPLICO culture initiatives and company values.
Attend staff meetings, in-services, and continuing education programs.
Promptly report safety hazards and support workplace safety initiatives.
Minimum Qualifications High School Diploma or GED required; Associate's Degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Accounting, or related field preferred. Minimum two (2) years of experience in business office administration, payroll, human resources, recruiting, or related functions. Experience with HRIS/payroll systems, preferably Workday. Knowledge of employment laws, onboarding practices, benefits administration, leave management, payroll processing, and personnel recordkeeping. Experience with Microsoft Office Suite, spreadsheets, databases, and office equipment. Strong organizational, communication, customer service, and time management skills. Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment when handling sensitive employee and business information.

It’s fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they are doing!
**Job Description:**
The Cal Poly Leadership & Service area consists of the Center for Leadership, the Center for Service in Action, Clubs & Organizations, Fraternity & Sorority Life and the College Corps Program which support the development of student leadership and service on campus and in the surrounding community. Their events and services encourage leadership skill development and competency, assumption of leadership and service roles, community building and collaboration, and the continuation of service to one’s community after graduation. We are committed to supporting the academic success of students by fostering the development of integrity and problem-solving skills; teaching self-empowerment and personal responsibility; and providing students with opportunities to learn and practice the fundamental principles of good citizenship, responsible leadership, and the importance of connection and respect in a global society.
Under the direction of the AmeriCorps Programs Assistant Director, the Administrative Coordinator provides support to the Coastal California Civic Leadership Consortium College Corps Program at Cal Poly. The Administrative Coordinator provides high-quality customer service, interprets and applies existing policies and procedures, maintains attention to detail and timeliness, and supports reporting, bookkeeping, and accounting duties.
This role provides general administrative support for College Corps including but not limited to; front desk and office organization, social media management, marketing, communications, and event logistics coordination to ensure College Corps program maintains operational efficiency and compliance with program requirements. With the support of leadership, the Administrative Coordinator leads coordination of College Corps events and logistics and supports the recruitment, training, and daily supervision of student assistants working with the team. This position works with partner campuses, host agencies, staff and faculty stakeholders, and Corps members to collect and organize data to ensure the compliance with reporting and other requirements for the grants that support these programs, and their potential ongoing renewal. All staff of the College Corps program team should be committed to the ongoing personal and professional development of students, assessing risk for member activities and working conditions of members, establishing and maintaining cooperative working relationships with constituents on- and off-campus, and performs effectively under the pressure of deadlines and other administrative demands.

Coordinate administrative functions of the Coastal California Civic Leadership Consortium College Corps program at Cal Poly, for its student fellows, consortium and community host partners.

Provide financial support to Assistant Director, and Administrative Analyst in processing invoices for payment (Accounts Payable), Deposits (Accounts Receivable), reconcile P-card for payment request and prepare travel claims for reimbursement/payment

Reconcile vendor statements to paid/outstanding invoices.

With support from the College Corps Administrative Analyst and Coordinator team, Lead planning and logistics for annual College Corps events: space reservations, scheduling, communications, hosting, registrations, day-of logistics.

Serve as primary contact to California Volunteers event contractors: coordination of regional Mid-Year event

Assist the Administrative Analyst to recruit, train and supervise student assistants for the Coastal California Civic Leadership Consortium

Develop and implement social media content calendars aligned with program goals.

Create engaging posts and graphics for various platforms (e.g., Facebook, Twitter, Instagram).

Monitor social media channels for engagement opportunities and respond to inquiries.

Coordinate the development of marketing materials such as flyers, newsletters, and digital campaigns.

Coordinate promotional activities to raise awareness and participation in program initiatives in collaboration with divisional marketing specialists and utilizing campus brand guidelines

Maintain office operations; order and stock supplies, inventory control, coordinate facility maintenance needs, mail distribution, and organization of file system and access.

Ensure office equipment is operating and properly maintained, arrange for necessary maintenance/repairs as needed.

Coordinate distribution and collection of program materials across campus departments and partner sites.

Schedule meetings, prepare agendas, and document key takeaways and follow-up actions.

Serve as a point of contact for inquiries related to member placements, site logistics, and program operations, consulting with leadership on complex or sensitive issues.

Assist the Administrative Analyst/Coordinator team, as needed with HR functions related to the recruitment, hiring, onboarding, evaluation, and timekeeping of College Corps students.

The High Voltage Administrative Assistant provides administrative and operational support to the High Voltage (HV) department, assisting project managers, estimators, field operations, and department leadership. This role is responsible for coordinating project documentation, maintaining records, supporting procurement and scheduling activities, tracking project deliverables, and ensuring accurate communication between internal teams, clients, vendors, and field personnel. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced construction environment. This role will be fully remote. Specific location details and expectations will be discussed during the interview process.

**Job Description:**

\\* This job description reflects management's assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned

**Position Responsibilities and Duties:**

Administrative Support
Provide administrative support to the High Voltage department leadership and project teams.

Maintain organized project files, correspondence, contracts, drawings, and documentation.

Prepare reports, presentations, meeting agendas, and meeting minutes.

Manage department calendars, appointments, and scheduling needs.

Coordinate travel arrangements and meeting logistics when required.

Project Coordination
Assist project managers with project startup, closeout, and general project administration.

Track project milestones, deadlines, submittals, RFIs, and change orders.

Maintain project logs and ensure documentation is current and accurate.

Support project teams with document distribution and document control processes.

Assist with project handoffs between business development, preconstruction, and operations.

Procurement & Vendor Support
Assist with purchase order creation, tracking, and filing.

Coordinate equipment and material deliveries with vendors and project teams.

Maintain vendor records and support procurement documentation.

Track lead times and assist with material status updates.

Financial & Reporting Support
Assist with invoice processing and documentation.

Support budget tracking and cost reporting activities.

Compile project data for management reporting.

Maintain accurate records related to project costs and expenditures.

Communication & Coordination
Serve as a point of contact
for internal departments, clients, vendors, and field personnel.

Coordinate communication between project managers, field supervisors, and stakeholders.

Assist in preparing customer correspondence and project updates.

Ensure timely distribution of project-related information.

Data Management
Enter and maintain data within project management, ERP, CRM, and document management systems.

Generate reports and dashboards as requested by management.

Maintain department databases and records with a high degree of accuracy.

## ROLE DESCRIPTION:

State Farm is a leading insurance agency dedicated to providing exceptional service to our customers. We are currently seeking a dynamic individual to join our team as a receptionist.
Our ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and committed to contributing to a positive and productive workplace. If you thrive in a supportive role and are eager to learn and grow within the insurance industry, we invite you to apply and become a valued member of our team.

## RESPONSIBILITIES:

Greet customers warmly in person and over the phone, directing them to the appropriate team members.

Manage appointment scheduling and office communications.

Assist in handling incoming inquiries and maintaining customer records.

Engage in conversations with prospective and existing customers, identifying opportunities to offer insurance options.

Provide excellent customer service and follow up on customers needs.

Support the team with various administrative tasks and projects.

## QUALIFICATIONS:

Communication and interpersonal skills.

Organizational and multitasking abilities.

Comfortable with engaging in sales conversations.

Basic computer skills, including Microsoft Office and CRM systems.

Starrcohawaii

Payroll Administrator 3 at Stride, Inc. Sacramento, California Payroll processing in Workday is required for this role! Accounting focuses on internal management financial reporting including: cost accounting (allocating and analyzing direct and indirect costs, actual vs. budgeted cost variance analysis, etc.); budget accounting (developing and monitoring annual revenue/expense budgets for the purpose of controlling funds and measuring operating results). High School diploma or GED, Associate's degree, or professional certificate, 5+ years of experience
The Payroll Administrator is responsible for managing the payroll process from start to finish. Duties may include reviewing and auditing timekeeping records to ensure compliance with established standards, handling tax notices, managing state and local registrations, processing tax adjustments, supporting year-end activities, and participating in other projects as assigned.
**Essential Functions:**
Responsible for the independent end-to-end preparation and processing of exempt/non-exempt (biweekly) multi-state payroll using Workday and OSV.
Reconcile payroll from period to period.
Calculate and review prorated wages and deductions when necessary (e.g., new hires, terminations, status changes).
Ensure tax and payroll deduction withholdings are accurate, including understanding of reciprocity rules.
Possess a solid understanding of Workday retros and their processing.
Maintain payroll records in compliance with SOX.
Troubleshoot and resolve payroll-related issues including tax adjustments for prior pay periods and years with minimal direction and supervision.
Consistently demonstrate customer service best practices by promptly addressing all employee inquiries, including tax and W-2 related questions-through the ticketing system, while ensuring compliance with SLA guidelines by resolving tickets within 24 to 48 hours.
Stay current on payroll and benefits legislation to ensure organizational compliance.
Independently manage all types of tax notices in collaboration with OSV, ensuring timely handling of notices, state and local registrations without delays.
Exhibit basic understanding of local tax requirements and termination laws across various states.
Assist with ad hoc management requests/projects (as requested) including but limited to year-end and W-2 as needed.
Supervisory Responsibilities: This position has no formal supervisory responsibilities.
**Minimum Required Qualifications:**
High School Diploma AND
Five (5) years of payroll experience INCLUDING
Three (3) years of Workday payroll experience OR
Equivalent combination of education and experience
Ability to clear required background check
**Other Required Qualifications:**
Familiarity with payroll processes, policies, and best practices.
Experience in using ticketing systems (e.g., Fresh service, Zendesk).
Proven ability to prioritize and re-prioritize effectively as business needs evolve.
Experience collaborating with a diverse group of stakeholders.
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to interact with all levels of the organization while delivering excellent customer service.
Problem-solving and judgment skills, with strong attention to detail.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Demonstrated commitment to the development and growth of team members.
Advanced interpersonal skills and a flexible, business-partner mindset.
Strong time management and task management skills.
Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.
Willingness to learn and take on new assignments.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
Availability to work in the Eastern Time Zone and to work overtime as approved and needed, primarily on payroll days or other key occasions only.
Payroll processing in Workday is required for this role! Certificates and Licenses: None Required
**Desired Qualifications:**
Associate or bachelor's degree in accounting, Finance or related field and (5) year of related experience and/or training
This position is virtual and open to residents of the 50 states, D.C.

$23 - $25 per hour

NOBEL Women

Accounts Payable Specialist
Location: Vernon, CA

Pay: $23-$25 per hour

Type: Contract-to-Hire

Industry: Food Manufacturing

About the Role
A fast-paced food manufacturing company in Vernon is looking for a detail-oriented Accounts Payable Specialist to support a high-volume AP workflow. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a deadline-driven environment, enjoys hands‑on transactional work, and is looking for a long‑term opportunity with potential to convert to permanent employment.

Key Responsibilities

Process a high volume of vendor invoices accurately and efficiently.

Review invoices for proper coding, approvals, and supporting documentation.

Match purchase orders, receipts, and invoices (3-way match).

Reconcile vendor statements and resolve discrepancies in a timely manner.

Assist with weekly check runs, ACH payments, and credit memos.

Maintain organized AP files and ensure compliance with company policies.

Communicate with internal departments and vendors regarding invoice or payment issues.

Support month-end AP closing tasks as needed.

Qualifications

2+ years of Accounts Payable experience, preferably in a high-volume environment.

Experience in manufacturing or food production is a plus.

Strong attention to detail and accuracy in data entry.

Ability to multitask and meet deadlines in a fast-moving environment.

Proficiency with ERP systems and Microsoft Excel.

Strong communication and problem‑solving skills.

Pay Details: $23.00 to $25.00 per hour

Benefit offerings available for our associates include medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, additional voluntary benefits, EAP program, commuter benefits and a 401K plan. Our benefit offerings provide employees the flexibility to choose the type of coverage that meets their individual needs. In addition, our associates may be eligible for paid leave including Paid Sick Leave or any other paid leave required by Federal, State, or local law, as well as Holiday pay where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled

Military connected talent encouraged to apply

### Job Description

Job Description

Job Summary

This role is ideal for a detail-oriented accounting professional with strong accounts payable experience and an interest in supporting vendor, subcontractor, and job cost-related payment processes.

The Accounts Payable Specialist will play an important role in keeping invoice processing, vendor records, payment runs, lien releases, retention tracking, and compliance documentation accurate and up to date. This is a great opportunity to join a stable, team-oriented accounting environment with supportive leadership, collaborative coworkers, and meaningful day-to-day ownership of the accounts payable function.

Key Responsibilities

\- Code invoices to the appropriate general ledger accounts, job cost codes, and cost centers.

\- Manage invoice approval workflows and process approved invoices for payment by ACH, check, or credit card.

\- Prepare bi-monthly check and ACH payment runs while ensuring proper supporting documentation is complete.

\- Reconcile vendor statements, system reports, processed payments, and outstanding balances.

\- Resolve discrepancies related to purchase orders, contracts, invoices, payments, and vendor documentation.

\- Support subcontractor compliance, including insurance certificates, W-9 forms, lien waivers, retention tracking, and year-end 1099 processing.

Compensation and Benefits

\- Pay: $25.00 to $35.00 per hour.

\- Job Type: Direct Hire.

$35 per hour

TeamBuilders Employment & Business Solutions
