### Job Description

Job Description

Company Description

TeamBuilders Employment and Business Solutions, LLC is a full-service staffing and consulting firm dedicated to identifying the best candidates for our clients’ open positions and the best career opportunities for our candidates. We have the ability to staff within all 50 states, so whether you are an employer with multiple locations or you are seeking employment outside of California, we can help.

A complete listing of open career opportunities may be accessed directly via our website at  -opportunities/

Job Description

TeamBuilders is hiring for an experienced **Certified Payroll Specialist** to join a thriving **commercial electrical construction & engineering** firm in the **Sacramento** area.

The Certified Payroll Specialist will take ownership of the subcontractor compliance process from project startup through completion. This includes reviewing new subcontracts, identifying prevailing wage and certified payroll requirements, monitoring ongoing compliance, auditing payroll documentation, resolving discrepancies, and maintaining accurate compliance records.

The ideal Certified Payroll Specialist brings strong knowledge of prevailing wage laws and public works labor compliance, exceptional attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and the ability to confidently work with subcontractors, accounting, project teams, and other internal and external stakeholders.

This is an excellent opportunity for a detail-oriented compliance professional who enjoys solving problems, improving processes, and playing an integral role in successful project execution.

This is a **Direct Hire, Full-Time position, Monday through Friday** , offering **up to $35.00 per hour, depending on experience** . The company also offers a comprehensive benefits package including **Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), and generous Paid Time Off (PTO).**

**Key Responsibilities of the Certified Payroll Specialist:**

**Certified Payroll & Subcontractor Compliance**

- Review new subcontracts and project requirements to identify applicable certified payroll, prevailing wage, labor compliance, insurance, and other regulatory requirements.
- Monitor subcontractor compliance with applicable state and federal payroll and labor regulations throughout the life of each project.
- Review and audit certified payroll reports, including documentation submitted by tiered subcontractors, to ensure completeness, accuracy, and compliance.
- Reconcile payroll and labor compliance information and identify discrepancies, omissions, or potential compliance issues.
- Work directly with subcontractors to obtain missing information, signatures, supporting documentation, and corrections in a timely manner.
- Research and resolve payroll and compliance discrepancies, responding effectively to questions from subcontractors, internal teams, and external stakeholders.
- Ensure subcontractor compliance requirements are satisfied prior to payment release in coordination with the Accounting Department.
- Maintain awareness of applicable prevailing wage, apprenticeship, labor compliance, and public works requirements.

**Project Startup & Documentation**

- Review new subcontracts and initiate the collection of required startup compliance documentation.
- Coordinate with subcontractors to ensure all required paperwork is complete, accurate, and submitted before project commencement.
- Maintain organized and accurate project compliance files and documentation.
- Track project-specific certified payroll, insurance, bonding, and subcontract compliance requirements.
- Maintain and update internal databases and compliance tracking systems to ensure current and reliable project information.

**Internal & External Collaboration**

- Serve as a primary point of contact for subcontractor compliance-related matters.
- Build professional, collaborative relationships with subcontractor representatives while maintaining appropriate compliance standards and deadlines.
- Partner with Project Management, Accounting, Operations, and other internal teams to ensure compliance requirements are understood and met.
- Communicate regulatory and contractual requirements clearly and professionally to both internal and external stakeholders.
- Support the timely resolution of compliance issues to prevent project delays or payment disruptions.

**Continuous Improvement**

- Identify opportunities to streamline compliance processes, improve accuracy, and increase operational efficiency.
- Lead and participate in continuous improvement initiatives related to subcontractor compliance and payroll processes.
- Participate in CECI Continuous Improvement events and methodologies as needed, including JDI, RIE, and A3 initiatives.
- Develop, maintain, and improve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for compliance processes and related functions.
- Stay current with changes in prevailing wage laws, labor regulations, reporting requirements, and industry best practices.

**General Responsibilities**

- Maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment when handling sensitive payroll, financial, contractual, and employee information.
- Manage multiple projects, deadlines, and competing priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
- Perform other related duties and responsibilities as assigned by management.

Qualifications

**Required Skills, Experience and Education of the Certified Payroll Specialist:**

**Education & Experience**

- Associate degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field preferred; equivalent combinations of education, technical training, and relevant construction industry experience will be considered. High school diploma or equivalent required.
- Minimum of 3 years of experience with prevailing wage laws and certified payroll reporting requirements, preferably involving federally and state-funded public works projects.
- Demonstrated experience interpreting and applying state and
- Federal prevailing wage and labor compliance requirements.
- Working knowledge of labor compliance, apprenticeship, and public works requirements for federally and state-funded projects.
- Construction industry experience strongly preferred.

**Technical Skills**

- Strong working knowledge of certified payroll and prevailing wage requirements.
- Experience using labor compliance and certified payroll platforms such as LCP Tracker, DIR, Spectrum, or comparable systems.
- Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, as well as Word and PowerPoint.
- Proficiency with Adobe and other document management tools.
- Strong data entry, database management, and 10-key skills.
- Ability to audit, reconcile, and process payroll and compliance information with a high degree of accuracy.
- Familiarity with subcontractor insurance and bonding requirements.

**Core Competencies**

- Exceptional attention to detail with the ability to identify discrepancies and ensure documentation is complete and accurate.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to research issues and develop practical solutions.
- Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain complex regulatory and contractual requirements clearly and professionally.
- Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
- Ability to establish and maintain productive relationships with subcontractors and internal stakeholders.
- Ability to adapt to changing regulations, project requirements, and shifting priorities while maintaining accuracy and quality.
- Demonstrated ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise discretion when handling sensitive information.
- Self-motivated and proactive, with a commitment to identifying opportunities for process improvement and operational efficiency.
- Collaborative team player who works effectively across departments and with diverse internal and external stakeholders.

If you have the skills & experience necessary to successfully perform the duties of the Certified Payroll Specialist and would like to be considered, please submit your resume and cover letter for immediate review. **Apply Directly** at **\- opportunities/certified -payroll-specialist/**

**Please Include Your Responses to the Following in Cover Letter or Email:**

- Your availability to interview and begin working onsite in the Sacramento area (specific date)
- Detailed description of your experience in Certified Payroll and how it directly relates with the duties listed in the job description
- Please confirm your level of education and any certifications you actively hold

Additional Information

**THIS POSITION IS ONSITE IN SACRAMENTO, CA (Not Remote, Not Hybrid)**

A Cover Letter & Resume are required for consideration

# Marketing Coordinator, Events

$70k - $80k

OpenSesame

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/6784901383615199874?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=18&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-4867883948982263453&crId=US_0US_0)

OpenSesame is the trusted partner for workforce reinvention in the age of AI. We deliver integrated software, curated and customizable content, and expert services embedded into existing learning, HR, and work systems to help organizations expand their human + AI potential and thrive through change.

As the Marketing Coordinator, Events, you will own execution of OpenSesame’s trade show and live event calendar, with a strong emphasis on even logistics and onsite execution. Events are a core engine of our integrated marketing campaigns, driving pipeline, accelerating deals, and building meaningful connections with prospective clients, enterprise buyers, and partners.

In this role, you’ll own hands‑on logistics and onsite execution across our event portfolio. You will bring a high‑energy, detail‑oriented approach to project management while leveraging modern marketing workflows and AI‑enabled tools to execute memorable, high‑impact experiences efficiently.

This role reports to the Manager of Integrated Campaigns, and will work alongside our Field Marketing Manager to execute our live event calendar, aligning localized field activations with broader brand initiatives and campaign milestones.

What You Own

End-to-End Event Execution: Plan, manage, and execute OpenSesame’s event calendar, including third‑party trade shows and field events.

Campaign & Cross-Functional Alignment: Translate Integrated Campaigns strategies into actionable event plans - partnering closely with your team members across marketing while aligning directly with Sales, Customer Success, and GTM Operations on audience targeting, messaging, and pipeline goals.

Logistics & Vendor Management: Own all operational details - booth logistics, contract negotiations, venue sourcing, staff scheduling, travel coordination, shipping, promotional materials, and vendor relationships.

Sales & Partner Enablement: Build pre‑event prep materials, coordinate booth/meeting staffing schedules, and equip sales representatives and partner managers with the tools and context needed to maximize onsite meetings and follow‑ups.

Budget & ROI Tracking: Manage event budgets down to the penny and track key event performance metrics (MQLs, meeting volume, pipeline contribution, cost-per-lead) to report performance against budget and targets for manager review.

AI & Modern Workflow Adoption: Integrate AI tools into your daily workflow to streamline event communications, build promotional copy faster, summarize event takeaways, and optimize event administrative tasks.

Performance Objectives
30 Days - Ramp Up & Foundations
Goal: Map the current landscape, learn OpenSesame’s event cadence, and step into ongoing event logistics.

Complete onboarding and set up 1:1s with key partners across Integrated Marketing, Sales, RevOps, and Partner teams.

Audit all active and upcoming Q3/Q4 events (live and digital) to understand commitments, contracts, timelines, and deliverables.

Shadow existing tradeshow and event operational workflows, including booth build/breakdown, to learn current tech stack, attribution tags, and CRM handoff points.

Take direct ownership of logistics for our upcoming events already on the calendar.

A 30-day event operations audit identifying current logistics risks, quick wins, and immediate resource needs.

Successful handoff and direct operational ownership of an active event.

60 Days - Ownership & Execution
Goal: Take full ownership of the event calendar, execute seamlessly, and optimize process efficiency.

Fully own the end-to-end execution of trade shows as well as support on field events, ensuring clean tracking, tight vendor management, and seamless pre/post-event sales handoffs.

Standardize the pre-event enablement process for sales reps attending field events (briefing documents, meeting schedules, target account lists).

Establish a repeatable post-event follow-up rhythm in partnership with demand gen and sales ops to guarantee rapid lead routing and campaign attribution.

Identify one manual event workflow (e.g., vendor communications, attendee follow-up copy, or speaker briefing docs) and implement an AI‑driven tool or template to accelerate it.

Clean, on‑budget execution of two live or virtual events with documented post-event metrics and lead routing.

Standardized Field Event Playbook for sales enablement and pre-event team prep.

One implemented AI-enabled workflow saving team time on event admin or content iteration.

90 Days - Impact & Growth
Goal: Drive predictable pipeline contribution through events and contribute to forward‑looking campaign strategy.

Contribute event-level performance data and takeaways — pipeline contribution, ROI, and partner participation — to the Q3/Q4 event retrospective.

Provide input on proposed event types, budget needs, and partner opportunities to support the 2027 events strategy.

Formalize a scalable event request and evaluation rubric to help the integrated marketing team evaluate incoming field/partner event opportunities against ideal customer profile (ICP) fit and cost efficiency.

Event performance data and input feeding the Q3/Q4 Event Portfolio Retrospective.

Documented input into the 6-month forward‑looking Event Roadmap and budget proposal.

Repeatable framework/rubric for evaluating incoming event sponsorship opportunities.

You might notice we don’t have the typical list of requirements and buzzwords here. That’s intentional.

We’re looking for proven examples from your career that show you can do this job, that you’ve built systems, driven alignment, and created impact at scale. When you look back a year from now, you’ll know you’ve made OpenSesame better, faster, and stronger because of your leadership.

Although it should go without saying (but it doesn’t), OpenSesame is an equal opportunity employer and we strive to create a welcoming, inclusive environment that celebrates diversity.

We use AI. For real.
Every team at OpenSesame works with AI tools daily, not as a buzzword, but as practice. You’ll build fluency that most companies are still talking about adopting, with hands‑on training and clear guardrails to experiment responsibly. AI amplifies your creativity and judgment. It doesn’t replace them. The skills you build here travel with you.

Location:
This position can be based anywhere in the US. We operate as a remote‑first company, and invest in mandatory all-company meetings several times a year in addition to required team travel of up to 15 days per year as necessary.

Travel Requirements:
Because this role directly supports OpenSesame’s trade show and live-event calendar, travel is an essential and required part of the position. The current estimate is approximately 10 events per year, with each trip typically lasting 3–4 days. The frequency, duration, and timing of travel may vary based on OpenSesame’s event calendar and evolving business needs.

Performance Driven:
We’re looking for self‑stators with a track record of delivering excellent results, but we’re highly selective about who we hire. We don’t focus on typical job requirements, instead, we’re interested in specific examples from your past experiences.

Fully Remote • Animal Outpatient Specialty Network Management Office, Remote
Job Type
Full-time
Description
Animal Outpatient Specialty Network (AOSN) is a privately owned, U.S.- based veterinary outpatient specialty company built around a unified group of board-certified veterinary specialists. Our doctors practice across surgery, dermatology, oncology, dentistry, ophthalmology, cardiology, and internal medicine.
AOSN has become the partner of choice for board-certified veterinary specialists and the provider of choice for pet parents throughout the United States — delivering exceptional patient care and real peace of mind for the pet parents we serve.
Position Summary
The Marketing Coordinator supports AOSN’s marketing initiatives and takes a primary role in the creative development of graphic design projects and the tactical execution of digital marketing campaigns. Working closely with the Marketing Manager and management team, this role translates corporate messaging and communication goals into compelling, persuasive marketing media for AOSN’s targeted customer segments.
Day to day, the Coordinator helps optimize our marketing programs by producing marketing materials, sourcing images and artwork, overseeing creative design, safeguarding brand standards, updating the company website, maintaining online assets, and handling general marketing activities. Creative thinking is essential to the work — driving our creative narrative, strengthening our brand, improving digital communication with clients, and supporting business growth through effective campaigns.

## KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**Creative and Design:**

- Work across a wide range of projects and media, using design software to visualize and develop original graphic designs that meet business goals.
- Develop design layouts and concepts based on business needs, incorporate stakeholder feedback, and manage each project through to successful deployment.
- Obtain input from management to ensure designs meet organizational standards and brand expectations, express ideas accurately, and represent the company appropriately.
- Examine existing creative processes, identify gaps, and develop solutions that improve design capabilities.
- Manage and organize company creative assets.

**Digital and Social Media:**

- Support the development, management, and execution of digital content streams (visual, audio, video) across both original and curated formats.
- Execute social media content production and distribution, and manage company social accounts.
- Collaborate with internal stakeholders and vendor partners to develop and source content for digital platforms.
- Update the company website and maintain online marketing assets.

**Project Management:**

- Work both independently and collaboratively with the marketing team, meeting deadlines and budget constraints.
- Schedule project implementation based on workload, which may include five or more simultaneous projects.

Requirements
**Education:**
• Degree in marketing, advertising, or a related field — or equivalent experience.
**Skills and Competencies:**

- Strong graphic design skills.
- Active and fluent across current social media platforms.
- Project management ability, with strong organizational and time management skills.
- Strong attention to detail.
- Focus and follow-through, with the ability to work efficiently and consistently meet deadlines.
- AOSN offers a compensation package commensurate with this opportunity. The expected base salary range for this position is $80,000 – $85,000. Actual compensation will depend on experience and qualifications.
- Comprehensive medical, prescription drug, dental, and vision coverage, Health Savings Accounts, and wellbeing support including free counseling and referral services.
- Savings and retirement resources, including a 401(k) plan, flexible spending accounts, retirement readiness tools, advisor support, rollover support, and financial wellbeing counseling.
- Life insurance, supplemental health protection plans, legal counseling, identity theft protection, commuter benefits, and more.

# Marketing Manager

Magic Hour Tea

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-5868723830205355430?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=8591349974958927107&crId=US_0US_0)

The Marketing Manager is responsible for bringing to life the strategy, planning and execution of the brand's digital marketing presence. This role serves as the central liaison between internal and external resources—managing meetings, coordinating creative, planning campaigns, maintaining launch calendars and executing content updates on all digital channels. This role is also responsible for learning, driving and protecting the voice of the brand and writing and/or guiding copy to support all marketing channels. This role requires flexibility working in a fast‑paced growing business and a unique blend of creativity, analytical insight, project management skill and hands‑on execution.

Responsibilities

Guide quarterly planning sessions for the team, maintaining the brand’s changing content calendar with campaign timelines and launch plans across website, email/SMS, social and paid marketing channels.

Work cross-functionally with all members of the brand, including CEO, CMO, operations, product, creative and web development to ensure alignment and timing of messaging, visuals and product details.

Write clear, on‑brand and optimized customer‑facing copy for our marketing channels, ensuring consistency and clarity.

Integrate deeply into Magic Hour’s communications channels, collaborating with founder, product director, designers, agencies, marketing and ecommerce/digital team members to create consistent, compelling messaging that speak to customers on their level, in their voice.

Provide agencies and consultants with clear creative briefs and assets and manage internal approvals to ensure content is brand‑consistent and effective.

Manage tagging, organization, and storage of creative assets in Dropbox and brand directories for internal and external use.

Maintain and grow the brand’s Shopify 2.0 website alongside external web design and development resources, including bug fixes, site updates, adding new products and bundles, creating sale pages, new collections, UX enhancements, feature rollouts, and CRO improvements.

Manage on site product listings and merchandising tasks on a weekly basis, including homepage and collection pages.

Oversee CRM and Loyalty programs alongside outside retention resources, building and deploying up to 5–7 weekly email campaigns in Klaviyo and SMS campaigns in Attentive weekly.

Support CMO in gathering and analyzing reported metrics from internal and external sources to build monthly marketing decks and impact strategy adjustments for continuous improvement.

Utilize analytics to understand user behavior, map customer journeys, and identify opportunities for growth and retention and prioritize optimizations alongside the CMO.

Qualifications

1+ years marketing copywriting experience

5+ years working in digital marketing space

Relentlessly curious and unwilling to settle for surface level understanding (we can’t provide clarity we don’t ourselves possess).

Highly proactive—you don’t wait for a brief to be assembled for you, and don’t expect things to be tidy. You find answers and aim to make things clearer/better than they’ve ever been.

Self‑starter, comfortable with ambiguity and the ability to juggle multiple priorities under tight deadlines in a fast‑paced, changing environment.

Extreme flexibility—while you’re a planner and able to prepare for what’s ahead with ease, you’ve worked in fast‑paced environments and embrace change as new opportunities emerge without getting discouraged.

You’re always ready for a changing landscape and teams can count on you to be the one to know what’s changed and how we’re solving for it.

Impeccable briefing skills, strong communication skills (written and verbal) and a proven track record of distilling details and processes into simple, digestible language.

Excellent time management and organizational skills.

Strong understanding of the digital marketing landscape and emerging digital tools, including experience with Shopify 2.0 and Klaviyo or similar platforms.

##### Office Assistant

Responsible for supporting the administrative functions and office duties of the department.

Essential Functions:

Provides administrative support to the Department, such as sending memos and department meeting invitations.

Answers incoming phone calls for the Social Services Department as a Receptionist.

Performs general office support, including filing, typing, faxing, copying, and other clerical tasks.

Provides administrative assistance on ordering office supplies and inventory, maintaining department supplies assignments, tracking order status, keeping order receipts, ordering monthly travel passes, office arrangements, and monthly expense reports.

Supports the Office Coordinator and assists with the day-to-day operations of the office by maintaining a clean and neat environment for clients and staff. Replenishes office supplies as needed.

Assists with workers' timesheet input and passes out workers' paychecks.

Assists with marketing tasks and disperses marketing materials.

Maintains and manages expense reports and data entry and keeps the reports in the file.

Prepares reports as required by funding sources.

Performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

A high school graduate with relevant housing experience. Bachelor's degree preferred.

Experience in providing health, social or aging services in the community.

Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills.

Must be self-motivated, organized, and able to multitask under minimal supervision.

Great attention to detail, good organizational skills, and ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks.

Proficient in MS Office and the Internet.

Must be bilingual in English and Cantonese. Biliterate in English and Chinese is a plus.

Must be able to travel via public transportation or personal vehicle for the performance of job duties. If driving, must have and maintain a valid CA driver's license, satisfactory driving record, and auto insurance coverage as specified in Self-Help's policy.

**Job Summary:**

Coordinates project timelines and resource allocation independently to ensure efficient execution of plans and schedules. Collaborates with cross-functional teams to align project milestones with organizational objectives and client expectations. Documents, tracks, and communicates schedule constraints, conflicts, and issues to the project team to support timely resolution and minimize impacts to project delivery. Maintains clear communication channels to facilitate transparency and timely updates for stakeholders. Supports continuous improvement by collecting feedback and lessons learned into future planning processes.

Develops and maintains detailed project schedules informed by precedents, ensuring alignment with overall project goals and deadlines.

Monitors progress against established timelines, proactively identifying and addressing potential delays or resource constraints.

Coordinates with internal and external partners to gather input, resolve standard and varied scheduling conflicts, and optimize resource utilization.

Communicates schedule updates and changes to relevant stakeholders in a timely and clear manner.

Documents general schedule changes and maintains accurate records to support project tracking and reporting.

Assists in integrating leading practices and lessons learned to improve future scheduling processes.

**Education Qualifications:**

Bachelor's degree in engineering, project management, a related field, or equivalent experience required.

**Work Experience:**

2 - 4 years of experience in project planning, scheduling, or a related field required.

Manage office inventory.

Greet clients and visitors.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Presentable appearance.

Ability to manage time efficiently under pressure.

TEEMA Group

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/580520745908602030?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=594&jdpSource=101&jdpid=6636717764434052921&crId=US_0US_0)

### Job Description

Job Description

Role Summary

Are you an organized, compassionate, and detail-oriented professional who excels at providing seamless administrative support in a vibrant care environment? We are seeking an energetic **Center Coordinator – Adult Day Program** to support operational excellence and foster a warm, inclusive community for older adults.

In this dynamic, key support role, you will work under the supervision of the Adult Day Program Manager to ensure smooth daily center operations, including activity logistics, caregiver scheduling, transportation routing, and electronic recordkeeping. You will serve as an essential ambassador for our patients and community members, championing a welcoming, empowering environment with a strong commitment to serving diverse populations, including LGBTQ seniors. If you thrive in an engaging, fast-paced setting and love helping others, we encourage you to apply!

Duties & ResponsibilitiesOperations & Care Coordination

- **Center Administration:** Provide broad administrative and operational support across daily program activities, meal services, personal care scheduling, intake needs, and patient/staff safety protocols.

- **Caregiver Team Support:** Collaborate with program management to assist in overseeing the caregiver team, including coordinate scheduling and daily workflow support.

- **Transportation & Scheduling:** Coordinate transportation logistics and routing to ensure patients arrive safely and on time for program activities.

- **Documentation & Data Entry:** Maintain accurate electronic records, complete required Electronic Health Record (EHR) data entry, and generate operational reports as requested.

- **Inclusive Environment:** Champion an inclusive, welcoming culture for all patients and community members, demonstrating sensitivity to diversity and intersectionality within the community.


- **Cross-Functional Partnering:** Work collaboratively with management and center staff to enhance program quality, operational efficiency, and overall team success.

- **Frontline Engagement:** Serve as a warm, professional point of contact for patients, families, and visiting partners, assisting with basic translation or interpretation as needed if bilingual.

- **Compliance & Safety:** Maintain a clean, orderly workspace and comply with all administrative, safety, background clearance, and health screening protocols (including TB testing).

- Other duties as assigned.


Required QualificationsEducation & Certifications

- **Education:** High School Diploma or GED equivalent.

- **Age Requirement:** Must be at least 18 years of age.

- **Certifications:** Active CPR and First Aid Certifications (required upon hire).

- **Clearances:** Ability to clear a standard background check and obtain required medical clearances (including health screening and TB test).


Experience & Technical Skills

- **Administrative Background:** Minimum of one (1) year of administrative, coordinator, or office support experience.

- **Computer Proficiency:** Skilled in Microsoft Office Suite, electronic scheduling systems, EHR platforms, and standard office technology.

- **Communication Skills:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a warm, professional, and patient-centered demeanor.

- **Adaptability & Organization:** Highly organized with exceptional multi-tasking skills, able to prioritize effectively in a busy environment with frequent interruptions.


Desired Qualifications

- **Community Specialty:** 2 to 4 years of experience working in healthcare, adult day care, or senior care settings, with a preferred focus or demonstrated interest in serving LGBTQ seniors.

- **Bilingual Ability:** Fluency in a second language is a strong plus (capable of providing basic translation for patients and staff).


Location and Work Type

- **Work Type:** Full-Time Position (Contract).

- **Work Setting:** On-Site Ambulatory/Day Center Environment.

- **Schedule:** Full-time (Monday– Friday - shift schedule).

HealthRIGHT 360

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

## Front Desk Receptionist

HealthRIGHT 360 gives hope, builds health, and changes lives for people in need by providing comprehensive, integrated, compassionate care that includes primary medical care, mental health services, and substance use disorder treatment.

The Integrated Care Center Clinic is a federally qualified health center that provides primary care, behavioral health, addiction treatment, psychiatry, dental care, and more. We provide care to those most in need including those who are suffering from homelessness, mental illness, substance use, and chronic medical conditions. We provide team-based care in an integrated care setting.

We are looking for a mission-driven, service leader who works well in a team, has experience with managing and supporting staff, champions quality improvement, leads change, and is excited to innovate.

Benefits and perks:

- HR360 offers a robust benefits package, including PTO, 15 paid holidays, commuter benefits, retirement plans, and more!
- Employees qualify for public loan forgiveness programs
- Training and professional development opportunities
- Work with mission-driven, compassionate colleagues and make a difference every day in the work that you do.

This is a union-eligible position.

The required work schedule for this position is:

JOB SUMMARY

HealthRIGHT 360, a nonprofit organization and a family of programs, is committed to providing accessible and comprehensive healthcare services to vulnerable populations. Our mission is to tackle systemic barriers to healthcare and promote health equity for all. We offer a wide range of services, including mental health care, residential and outpatient substance use treatment, and primary health services. Additionally, we provide transitional support for individuals re-entering the community after involvement in the criminal justice system. By integrating physical and behavioral health, we empower individuals to overcome challenges by addressing social determinants of health, fostering resilience, and facilitating recovery.

The Front Desk Receptionist assists the agency with day-to-day functions, which includes a rotation of front desk intake/registration, scheduling, training of interns & volunteers, and work as a call receptionist for our administrative & clinic departments.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Clinic Intake Responsibilities:

- Schedules medical clinic appointments and directs calls throughout the agency.
- Assists with enrolling patients into HSF (Healthy San Francisco) program.
- Makes follow-up calls for providers; calls to confirm "next day's appointments".
- Greets and provides customer service to patients, guests, clients, and vendors.
- Communicates clearly on the phone and accurately takes and delivers messages.
- Works at other locations when needed.

Documentation Responsibilities:

- Performs general administrative tasks such as filing, organizing, data entry, and billing.
- Assists in maintaining computerized appointment system (Mysis) or other assigned system.
- Processes patient/client data entry for company various electronic systems in accordance with guidelines established by HealthRIGHT 360 to satisfy internal and external evaluating requirements.

Administrative Responsibilities:

- Manages receipt and routing of agency mail (incoming and outgoing).
- Assists and directs callers and visitors to appropriate employees and departments.
- Ability to operate a single or multiple position telephone switchboard. Works in a team-oriented environment.
- Orientation, training, and supervision of volunteers on certain front desk responsibilities may be assigned.

And perform other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education, Certification, and Experience:

- High school diploma or equivalent.
- Prior experience in front desk reception, administrative, and/or customer service.
- Experience working with staff and volunteers.

- Preferably 2 years' experience working in a medical front office setting, preferably in a community clinic with medical experience.
- Preferably MISYS and One-E-App experience (CAA Certified).
- CPR certification and First Aid certification.

Knowledge:

- Knowledge of HIPAA regulations.
- Working knowledge of computerized medical scheduling and billing systems.

- Familiarity with other community agencies in the Bay Area to make appropriate referrals preferred.
- Understanding of harm reduction philosophy and ability to provide non-judgmental, client-centered services preferred.

# Experienced Veterinary Receptionist

$22 - $27 per hour

Berkeley Animal Hospital

[Berkeley, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Berkeley%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-1413061223585990581?p=1&pos=0&rgn=5897&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=1505529736609409383&crId=US_0US_0)

##### Veterinary Receptionist (CSR)

Join a growing, privately owned veterinary practice where great medicine starts with great people. Berkeley Animal Hospital opened its doors in June 2023, and we've been growing quickly ever since. We're a newly constructed, privately owned general practice in Berkeley looking for an experienced Veterinary Receptionist (CSR) to join our team. We're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys helping people and animals, takes pride in doing things the right way, and wants to be part of a thoughtful, collaborative team.

##### What We're Looking For:

You're someone who:

- Has at least 1 year of experience working as a CSR in a veterinary hospital.
- Is passionate about veterinary medicine and animal well-being.
- Brings warmth, professionalism, and empathy to every client interaction.
- Believes in ethical, respectful, and thoughtful patient care.
- Communicates openly and is comfortable giving constructive feedback to management.
- Values a positive workplace and contributes to a culture built on teamwork rather than gossip.
- Is organized, dependable, detail-oriented, and able to stay calm when things get busy.
- Is interested in learning more about Fear Free techniques or bringing your existing Fear Free experience to our practice.
- Bilingual or multilingual communication skills are a plus, but not required. We appreciate team members who can help make veterinary care more accessible and welcoming to a diverse community.

##### What You'll Do:

As a CSR, you'll be one of the first faces our clients see and an important part of creating a positive experience for both pets and their people. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

- Welcoming clients and their pets with a friendly, compassionate approach.
- Answering phone calls, text messages, and emails.
- Scheduling and coordinating appointments.
- Checking clients and patients in and out.
- Processing payments and handling basic financial transactions.
- Maintaining accurate documentation of client communications as required by law.
- Providing basic information about veterinary services and products.
- Supporting veterinarians and veterinary technicians with administrative tasks.
- Keeping the front desk and reception area clean, organized, and welcoming.
- Using multiple digital platforms, including Windows, Gmail, and Google Drive.
- Working in Neo, our cloud-based practice management system. If you haven't used Neo before, we'll train you!

##### What You Bring:

- Minimum 1 year of veterinary CSR experience.
- High school diploma/GED, or equivalent education and experience.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- Ability to multitask and prioritize in a fast-paced veterinary environment.
- Professional, dependable, and team-oriented attitude.
- Comfort working with computers and multiple digital platforms.
- Flexibility to work some weekends.

##### Why Berkeley Animal Hospital?

We're a young and growing practice with the opportunity to help shape the culture and client experience as we continue to grow. If you're looking for a veterinary hospital where your voice matters, teamwork is valued, and excellent patient and client care are taken seriously, we'd love to hear from you. We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, along with opportunities for professional growth and development. If you're an experienced veterinary CSR who loves people, loves animals, and takes pride in creating an exceptional client experience, we encourage you to apply.

##### Physical Requirements:

The physical demands described here are representative of those required to perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions. This position requires the ability to regularly stand, walk, use hands to handle objects, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, crawl, sit, talk, and hear. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 50–75 pounds. Specific vision abilities required include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

##### Job Details:

- **Job Types:** Full-time.
- **Pay:** $22 to $27 Hourly, based on experience.
- **Benefits:**
 - 401(k).
 - Health + Dental Insurance.
 - Employee discount.
 - PTO.

##### About Berkeley Animal Hospital:

We are a privately owned small animal clinic (general practice care). We have a 3000 square foot facility with 5 exam rooms, a large treatment area, a dental suite, a surgery suite, and free warming cages. We offer acupuncture and have on-call specialists who include internal medicine, cardiology, and surgery.

## Executive Assistant

Watney is hiring its first Executive Assistant to support our founding team as we scale. You'll be a core part of how our founders operate, keeping our key leaders moving fast, organized, and focused on what matters most.

This is a high-trust, high-impact role. Our founders are moving quickly and won't always have a perfect picture of what they need. Your job is to reduce friction before it happens: building organized systems, thinking ahead, and creating an environment where nothing important gets dropped. This role is fully embedded in the team, requiring 5 days/week onsite in SF, and plugged into everything happening at Watney.

If you are highly organized, take ownership instinctively, and find satisfaction in making a high-functioning team run even smoother, then this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

## What You'll Do

- Manage calendaring and scheduling for the founding team including external meetings, internal syncs, and cross-timezone coordination

- Identify gaps before they become problems and build lightweight systems that keep things from falling through the cracks

- Own inbox management and correspondence for the co-founder

- Handle travel logistics: flights, hotels, ground transport, and itineraries

- Plan and coordinate events including team dinners, offsites, and special occasions

- Partner with the Ops Manager on office tasks and facilities logistics


## You May Be a Good Fit If You:

- Have experience as an Executive Assistant or in a similarly operational support role, ideally at a fast-moving startup

- Are exceptionally organized: You're already three steps ahead and you can confidently land complex, multi-party meetings

- Communicate clearly and discreetly: You handle sensitive information with care and professionalism

- Take ownership naturally: If something needs to get done, you do it without being asked twice

- Are excited to be in the office five days a week, embedded in the team, and part of the day-to-day energy of building something from the ground up

- Are familiar and comfortable with: Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Notion, basic spreadsheets, Brex/Ramp (bonus: Slides/Canva and Ashby)

- Have experience with facilities, office management, or food coordination (a plus)


We're committed to building a diverse, inclusive team. At Watney Robotics, we welcome people of all backgrounds and identities, and we make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential. If you're passionate about robotics but don't meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply!

Job Description Become an integral part of the Commercial Banking team where you will have the opportunity to work in a fast-paced organization and each day will be unique! This role provides a platform for professional growth and skill enhancement. Be part of a team that is results-oriented, with a focus on attention to detail and quality.
As an Executive Administrative Assistant supporting Commercial Banking, you will manage busy calendars, travel, plan and assist with local events and projects for the business and may support various activities such as managing tactical office needs, client tickets, compliance requirements or business travel tax. You will tap into your thought leadership to manage priorities, ensure efficient use of executives’ time, and collaborate closely with colleagues to ensure robust on-site support and backup coverage. You will also work with key stakeholders in the business, partner with various teams (Office Management, etc.) to complete projects.
**Job Responsibilities:**
Manage complex calendars for leaders in a fast paced and dynamic environment, arrange travel plans, adjust and prioritize last-minute changes including logistics such as conference rooms, events, and catering, etc.
Support local event planning and execute as needed and/or support local employee engagement activities such as team recognition, events, etc.
Provide required physical demand providing site support for local office requirements including phone coverage, assistance with new hire integration, facilities maintenance, supplies, floor access, presence at local events, greeting clients and guests and escorting them throughout the location, food orders/set up and takedown of conference rooms, ensuring superior client service at all times
Maintain confidential data, enforce internal controls, and comply with policies and procedures
Support Catalyst or other LOB reporting activity within scope for role and simple reporting for the business such as pulling canned reports and scorecards
Provide general team support such as time keeping, training tracking, and assist in ad hoc projects as needed
Collaborate effectively with colleagues and team members, assisting with projects and tasks as needed
Provide service-oriented support by greeting clients, distributing packages, restocking pantry items, and performing other floor duties as required.
Exhibit strong knowledge of invoice payment processing and/or Sponsorship and Donation processes
Commit to exceptional customer service and ability to work in team-oriented environment tied to solid judgment, decision making and problem solving skills
**Required qualifications, capabilities and skills:**
Strong organizational skills and ability to work independently in a demanding, changing and fast paced environment
Effective travel planning skills and knowledge
Self-motivated, personal leadership, ability to be discrete, highly collaborative and team oriented
Effective interpersonal skills and excellent communication - confident, organized, and clear
Fluent in Microsoft Office, PitchPro and Adapts easily to process changes and learns new technologies quickly
At least three years of administrative support experience with background in a client facing sales and financial services environment
**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills:**
Experience supporting at the Managing Director level (or equivalent) or above
College degree is a plus

$80k - $110k

**Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.**

Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

Location Note: This is a **Mountain View, CA-based** role. Although the posting lists San Francisco for now, the position is on-site in Mountain View. Please consider this when applying.

## **Overview:**

The Executive Assistant, Design is a trusted partner to the EVP, Head of Design and provides senior-level administrative support to 1-2 of her direct reports, enabling the Design leadership team to focus on creative and strategic priorities. This role manages complex calendars, coordinates travel and events, and handles sensitive organizational information with sound judgment and discretion. The EA operates under general supervision, exercising independent judgment on day-to-day prioritization and escalating higher-stakes or sensitive matters to the EVP.

## **Responsibilities include but are not limited to:**

- Manage complex, high-volume calendars for the EVP and her direct reports, proactively resolving scheduling conflicts and prioritizing time against evolving business needs

- Coordinate all domestic and international travel logistics and expense reporting for the

- Design leadership team, and lead planning and on-the-ground logistics for offsites and team collaboration events

- Execute expense management activities with minimal guidance

- Assess and advocate for office space needs with minimal guidance

- Serve as a key point of contact between the EVP’s office and stakeholders across Product & Technology, HR, Legal, Finance, and external vendors/partners, independently determining what can be handled directly versus what requires escalation

- Partner with other Product & Technology executive assistants to coordinate cross-organization initiatives and provide backup coverage for one another as needed

- Support onboarding logistics for new hires into the Design organization

- Lead or support ad hoc special projects as assigned by the EVP


## **Basic Qualifications:**

- 5+ years of experience supporting a senior executive (VP level or above), ideally within a creative, design, product, or technology organization

- Proven ability to manage complex, fast-changing calendars and competing priorities with sound judgment and minimal oversight

- Extensive experience coordinating domestic and international travel arrangements and managing expense reporting

- High proficiency with Google Workspace; comfortable adopting new productivity and AI tools

- Exemplary written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with senior executives, creative talent, and external partners

- Demonstrated discretion and professionalism in handling confidential and sensitive information

- Experience planning and executing team offsites and events, including vendor and logistics coordination


## **Additional Qualifications:**

- Prior experience supporting a Design, UX, Creative, or Product leader or organization

- Experience in media, entertainment, or technology industries

- Familiarity with Paramount’s internal systems (e.g., Oracle Fusion)

- Experience supporting or coordinating across multiple executives/leaders concurrently

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience preferred


Paramount Streaming, a division within Paramount Global, is the home to the company's direct-to-consumer services spanning free and paid in the form of Pluto TV and Paramount+. Pluto TV is the global leader in free ad-supported TV, delivering more than 1,400 global channels and an extensive library of streaming content, including live and original channels. Paramount+, digital subscription video-on-demand and live streaming service, combines live sports, breaking news, and A Mountain of Entertainment™. Paramount+ features an expansive library of original series, hit shows and popular movies across every genre from world-renowned brands and production studios, including SHOWTIME®.

# Executive Assistant

Ella Baker Center for Human Rights

[Oakland, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Oakland%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-5956244728206349678?p=1&pos=0&rgn=5907&pageType=7&jobAge=114&jdpSource=101&jdpid=3024820512148711378&crId=US_0US_0)

The Executive Assistant provides exceptional administrative, logistical, and on-site support to the Executive Director and Leadership Team. This role is vital in enhancing productivity, maintaining confidentiality, and ensuring seamless operations both internally and externally. Additionally, the Executive Assistant facilitates communication and coordination for the Board of Directors, ensuring efficient preparation and execution of key meetings and annual engagements.
This position requires high-level time management and organizational skills, the ability to anticipate needs, and a proactive, intuitive approach to managing priorities. Serving as the primary point of contact for the Executive Director, the Executive Assistant also acts as a liaison with the Board of Directors. The ideal candidate will demonstrate excellent judgment across diverse situations, possess strong written and verbal communication skills, balance priorities seamlessly, and handle confidential matters with the highest level of care and discretion. This full-time, on-site, salaried position works one-on-one with the Executive Director and requires a flexible individual who thrives in a mission-driven, results-oriented, and community-focused environment.

## HOW TO APPLY

Submit a resume or summary of relevant experience.
Submit a thoughtful cover letter about your interest in the position.
Provide a writing sample, selecting one of the following prompts: End-of-year look back to the Board of Directors; or an announcement to all staff welcoming a new team member.
Should a candidate advance in the interview process, they may be asked to participate in a brief skills evaluation exercise.

##### Bookkeeper / Accounting Manager

Walnut Creek, CA \| On-Site

Full-Time \| $90,000 per year

Safe and Sound Security is California's fastest-growing commercial security integrator. We specialize in commercial security systems and data cabling and have been serving businesses for over 15 years. With rapid growth and increasing operational complexity, we're seeking an experienced Bookkeeper / Accounting Manager to oversee financial operations and ensure accurate, timely reporting.

This role is ideal for a detail-oriented professional with QuickBooks expertise and experience managing bookkeeping processes in a growing company.

##### What You'll Do

- Manage Financial Operations: Oversee accounts payable and receivable, payroll, and general ledger maintenance.
- QuickBooks Oversight: Maintain and optimize QuickBooks Online workflows for accuracy and efficiency.
- Financial Reporting: Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports, and support management with actionable insights.
- Tax & Compliance: Ensure timely sales tax filings, payroll tax compliance, and other regulatory reporting.
- Process Improvement: Recommend and implement bookkeeping and accounting process improvements to drive operational efficiency.
- Team Collaboration: Work cross-functionally with operations, HR, and management to support strategic initiatives.
- Mentorship & Leadership: Guide junior accounting staff or assistants as the team grows.

##### What We're Looking For

- Experience: 5+ years of bookkeeping or accounting experience, preferably in QuickBooks Online.
- Strong knowledge of accounts payable/receivable, payroll, reconciliations, and financial reporting.
- Detail-oriented, organized, and capable of managing multiple priorities with minimal supervision.
- Excellent communication skills and ability to work collaboratively across teams.
- Experience in a fast-growing company or small business environment is a plus.
- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field preferred but not required.
- On-site availability in Walnut Creek, Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM.

##### Compensation & Benefits

- $90,000 annual salary
- Health, dental, and vision insurance
- 401(k) with company match
- Flexible PTO
- On-site parking in Walnut Creek
- Opportunity for career growth into Controller or Finance Manager roles as the company expands

##### Why Safe and Sound

- Join a fast-growing, innovative company with a team-oriented culture
- Work with modern tools and cloud-based systems to streamline financial operations
- Make a tangible impact on the company's growth and financial health
- Participate in team events, celebrations, and cross-functional collaboration

### Job Description

Job Description

**Accounts Payable and Receivable Specialist Job Description**

**Job Description**\- With excellent organizational skills, the primary responsibility of the Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable Specialist will be to assist the accounting team to ensure the proper and accurate entry and coding of accounting related transactions, invoices, expense reports, and the timely submission of customer invoices and payments.  The successful Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable Specialist will be highly proficient in coding invoices to multiple cost centers conforming to standard procedures to ensure proper entry into the financial system and excellent at applying payments accurately.  Strong internal and external facing communication skills is required to understand purchases, invoices and payments for proper allocation and reporting. Additional responsibilities for the Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable Specialist include the following:

**Responsibilities Include:**

- Codes such items as invoices, vouchers, expense reports, check requests, etc. with correct codes conforming to standard procedures to ensure proper entry into the financial system
- Handles all vendor correspondence via phone or email
- Prepares non-inventory purchase order requisitions.
- Attaches the corresponding purchase orders to incoming invoices with all supporting documentation.
- Investigates and resolves problems associated with processing of invoices and purchase orders.
- Prepares batch check runs, wire transfers, and ACH transactions.
- Assists with the processing of month end accruals for monthly financial reports, and monthly closings.
- Reconciles various accounts by identifying errors in posting or omissions by applying appropriate accounting standards.
- Receives, researches and resolves a variety of routine internal and external inquiries concerning account status, including communicating the resolution of discrepancies to appropriate persons.
- Prepare and send all customer billing.
- Produce the monthly aging report.
- Respond to customer billing inquiries, resend bills, and send collection emails.

**Requirements**

- 1 - 2 years accounts payable and receivable or general accounting experience
- 10-key by touch
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Strong organizational skills; must be detail oriented, ability to multi-task
- Proficient in Microsoft Excel and other financial systems.

**Education**

- Bachelor's degree preferred.

**Benefits**

- PTO, PST, Medical, Dental, and Vision

**About You:**
Are you extremely organized? Do you take a proactive approach to solving problems? Do you act with integrity and hold yourself to the highest standard? If the answer is, “Yes!” then we have an opportunity that will excite you. Who are we? We are ARCO, a Family of Construction Companies.

ARCO/Murray National Construction is currently looking for a detail-oriented, self-reliant Project Coordinator to join our team. At ARCO, you’ll have the opportunity to improve project performance, set up processes and drive your own success from day one!

**A Day in the Life:**

Typing/preparing various items such as letters, bid instructions, meeting minutes, weekly updates, memos, proposals, outline specifications, timesheets, and expense reports

Assist Project Managers with Proposals by typing up proposal letters, outline specifications, manage the work/design schedule and assemble proposal books in a timely manner as per Project Manager

Maintain various lists for Project Managers including job list for each region, subcontract tracking list, filing and vacation lists

Prepare various forms as directed by Projects Managers (Subcontracts, Purchase Orders, Change Orders, AGC Agreements, Professional Service Agreements, and transmittals)

Point person for proposal and capabilities packages. This includes putting together proposal covers, tabs, company information, sell sheets and then assembling once provided with rest of the materials by Project Manager

Preparation for meetings and trainings including scheduling, preparing handouts, and coordinating lunches

Book all travel when necessary

Answer incoming phone calls and coordinate communication with vendors and customers in the event of a Project Manager’s absence

Maintain all files, including preparing new files and sending old files off site

**Necessary Qualifications:**

3-10 years of related experience, construction administration experience considered a plus

Excellent computer skills, must be proficient in Microsoft Word and Excel

Must be extremely organized, self-reliant, proactive, and detail-oriented

**What We Can Offer You:**
We are dedicated to the well-being of our associates and are proud to be consistently recognized as a Best Place to Work. Our compensation and benefits package not only supports our associates and their families but benefits local communities and communities around the world.

Industry-leading performance-based bonus program

Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)

Traditional and Roth 401k

Tuition reimbursement for associates

Scholarship for associates’ children up to $28,000 per child

1-month paid sabbatical after every five years of employment, plus $5,000 for travel

1-week paid volunteer leave each year

100% charitable match

Medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage

Paid parental leave

Typical base compensation for the Project Coordinator role is between $72,000 and $96,000. Candidates with extensive experience may exceed this range. In addition to base salary, the role is eligible to receive discretionary bonus compensation based on individual and company.

# P&C Operations Coordinator

$89.49k - $128.41k

IKEA Carson Home Furnishings

[Emeryville, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Emeryville%2C-CA)

Why we will love you
You believe the heart of any business is its people. You understand greatness requires thinking differently. An inclusive and accepting work environment is important to you. At IKEA, we work to make a better everyday life for the many. It's the perfect fit if you want to contribute, grow, and share your uniqueness. Join our team and start a better life for yourself.

What you'll be doing day to day

Execute operational P&C activities, collaborating with other LOS Specialists as needed to deliver an excellent co-worker experience.

Ensure and execute delivery of learning activities at unit/function level including legally required trainings.

Ensure local employer communication activities including events are consistent, well perceived and build on the IKEA brand.

# Business Operations Manager

Cooper

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-9004459477822834786?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=114&jdpSource=101&jdpid=262473797239735357&crId=US_0US_0)

**About Cooper AI**

Cooper is an AI coworker for the insurance industry. Getting a business insured involves mountains of paperwork: filling out repetitive forms, re-typing the same information into one insurance company's website after another, and comparing offers by hand. Cooper does that busywork automatically, right inside the tools people already use, so brokers and their teams can focus on advising clients instead of pushing paper. We're a small team with deep insurance roots, teaching AI to do real, trusted work in a massive, overlooked industry.

Backed by Lightspeed, General Catalyst, and Valor, Cooper AI is building from the ground up to modernize a $1T+ global insurance industry.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a Business Operations Manager to help us scale intelligently as Cooper grows. This is a high-impact generalist role sitting directly alongside our leadership team - you'll work across the organization to identify strategic opportunities, bring structure to ambiguity, and drive execution on the initiatives that matter most.

No two weeks will look the same. You might be building a framework to evaluate a new market opportunity one week and redesigning a customer-facing process the next. You're someone who identifies the problem, defines the approach, and gets moving.

**What You'll Do**

- Own high-priority, cross-functional initiatives end-to-end - from scoping and analysis through execution and measurement
- Partner with executive leaders to define and prioritize the most critical strategic questions facing the business
- Conduct quantitative and qualitative analyses - market sizing, competitive landscape, unit economics - and turn findings into clear, actionable recommendations
- Identify operational bottlenecks and design process improvements that drive efficiency and margin across the business
- Develop and maintain critical operating metrics and reporting cadences, communicating insights to senior stakeholders in a clear, compelling way
- Serve as a connective layer across Product, GTM, Revenue, and Customer teams - aligning stakeholders, facilitating decisions, and removing blockers

ID

Overview

If you reside in California, please see our California Applicant Privacy Policy for more information about our data handling practices and your data rights.

Responsibilities

MV Transportation is seeking a **Dispatcher** who works to direct the day-to-day route operations and report to the Dispatch Supervisors. This work is done in compliance with the procedures defined by the client and in conformance with company procedures. His/her duties involve daily communication and interaction with drivers and clients. He/she must also organize and conduct activities to assure safe, cost-effective, on-time operating performance. Tracks and reports sign-in/sign-out times, assures routes are timely, and communicates service issues to the Dispatch Supervisors or Dispatch Managers as appropriate.

**Job Responsibilities:**

Takes client calls and communicates issues with drivers and Dispatch Supervisors or Dispatch Managers as appropriate. - Monitors radio, telephones and on-road provision of service for quality.
- Responsible for influencing positive employee morale and quality customer service.
- Monitors and completes driver sign-in and sign-out daily.
- May assign trips to drivers to assure adequate disbursement of trips between all assigned routes.
- Monitors daily system performance.
- Participates in analysis and review of operating performance.
- Notes closed and/or late starting of routes and communicates same to Dispatch Supervisors and/or Dispatch Managers as appropriate.
- Must be able to operate vehicles to cover routes in the event of a shortage of drivers.
- All other duties, as assigned.

Qualifications

**Talent Requirements:**

- One (1) year previous Dispatcher experience preferred.
- Two (2) years of Customer Service experience is preferred.
- High School diploma or equivalent.
- Experience with Trapeze software.
- Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and maintain composure under pressure in a fast pace environment.
- Demonstrate a high customer service commitment.
- Able to demonstrate professional phone manner.
- Knowledge of the service area is a plus.
- Must have CDL B with Passenger & Air Brakes Endorsement

# Operations Manager

$5,000 - $6,000 per month

Full-time

Somewhere

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-1881488912461498791?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=498&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-7416867025907393384&crId=US_0US_0)

Operations Manager

Location: San Francisco Bay Area CA (On-Site / In-Person)

Position Type: Full-Time

Compensation: $5000 $6000 Base Salary Performance-Based Revenue Commission

Sourcing Location: Onshore / Local (San Francisco Bay Area)

Hiring Timeline: 2 to 4 weeks

## Role Overview

We are a premier high-volume residential and commercial field services provider in the San Francisco Bay Area. Handling approximately 200 service calls per day the company operates a fast-paced 24/7 service model delivering emergency repairs spring replacements opener installations and custom door solutions.

We are seeking an experienced on-site Operations Manager to take complete operational ownership across field technician management office operations CSR supervision and revenue growth. Serving as the primary operational leader on the ground you will recruit train and dispatch service technicians manage in-office customer service representatives optimize job conversion rates and streamline workflows using our Dispatch CRM.

This role requires a candidate who knows the garage door industry inside and out possesses deep native knowledge of Bay Area geography and brings strong leadership to drive company revenue and service efficiency.

## Key Responsibilities

### Field Technician Management & Leadership

- Recruit & Onboard: Hire onboard and train field service technicians across the San Francisco Bay Area service territory.
- Coaching & Upselling: Conduct hands-on field training safety checks and upsell coaching to increase average ticket sizes and conversion rates.
- Performance Monitoring: Oversee live field progress job completion rates and technician schedules in the Dispatch CRM.
- Field Support: Address technician escalations complex technical requirements and field emergencies promptly.
- Fleet & Inventory: Manage inventory tracking truck stock replenishment and maintenance for field service vehicles.

### Office Operations & Customer Care

- CSR Supervision : Directly supervise in-office Customer Service Representatives (CSRs) and dispatch staff to ensure efficient call handling and high booking rates.
- Call Volume Management: Oversee daily call intake (200 calls/day) ensuring rapid dispatch turnarounds for urgent service requests.
- Customer Escalations: Resolve complex customer service inquiries and maintain high customer satisfaction across all service zones.
- Financial Reconciliation: Reconcile daily job receipts invoicing accuracy and payment collections between field and office teams.

### Strategy & Revenue Growth

- Revenue Strategy: Execute initiatives aimed at increasing monthly revenue expanding average job values and hitting target profit margins.
- Route & Dispatch Optimization: Leverage local Bay Area geographic familiarity to optimize dispatch routes response times and technician productivity.
- Bottleneck Elimination: Analyze call intake metrics and conversion rates to streamline daily workflows and remove operational friction.
- Executive Partnership : Partner with company leadership to set operational targets refine commission frameworks and expand service capacity.

## Qualifications & Skills

- Industry Experience : 25 years of hands-on operations or field management experience specifically in the garage door repair and installation industry (former technicians service managers or dispatch leads preferred).
- Technical Knowledge : Deep working knowledge of garage door parts springs openers commercial systems and repair pricing structures.
- Local Geography: Native familiarity with San Francisco Bay Area geography transportation corridors and local market dynamics.
- Leadership & Hiring : Proven track record of recruiting training and managing field technicians and in-office customer service teams.
- Software Proficiency: Practical experience with Dispatch CRM (or equivalent field service scheduling platforms) VoIP phone systems and fleet GPS tracking tools.
- Drive & Accountability: Results-driven mindset focused on increasing revenue technician productivity and customer retention.

Technology & Tools

Candidates should be proficient with or capable of quickly mastering

- Dispatch CRM (Field Service & Scheduling Management Software)

- High-Volume Business Phone Systems & VoIP Platforms

- GPS Tracking & Fleet Management Software

- Google Workspace & Microsoft Office Suite

- Digital Invoicing & Field Payment Processing Systems

## Working Hours & Schedule

- Format : Full-Time On-Site (Monday Friday standard office hours).
- Operational Flexibility : Because ACES Garage Door operates a 24/7 high-volume service model (with peak call volume running until 10:00 PM) the Operations Manager must maintain operational flexibility to support off-hour escalations when necessary.

About the Role
We're looking for an

HR Onboarding Specialist

to ensure every new employee joins Wing with confidence, clarity, and a seamless introduction to the organization. This role is a key part of the HR team, working closely with Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, and Organizational Development to guide new hires from offer acceptance through full integration. The HR Onboarding Specialist will deliver structured onboarding sessions, manage documentation and system setup, and ensure every new team member is fully oriented to Wings culture, processes, and expectations.

Key Responsibilities

Manage and execute the end-to-end onboarding process for new hires, from offer confirmation to HR and departmental handover.

Conduct new hire orientations covering company policies, culture, communication standards, HR procedures, and performance expectations.

Ensure timely setup of system access, credentials, and HR-related accounts prior to a new hire's start date.

Collaborate with Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, and relevant departments to verify completion of pre-employment and onboarding requirements.

Maintain warm, clear, and proactive communication with new hires throughout the onboarding journey, addressing questions and concerns.

Track onboarding progress, maintain checklists, and ensure timely completion of all required HR and compliance steps.

Collect, organize, and report feedback from new employees to enhance the onboarding experience and engagement.

Coordinate with People Operations and Compliance teams for documentation, contract execution, policy acknowledgments, and regulatory requirements.

Support new hire's transition into role-specific training or departmental integration, ensuring no gaps in information, setup, or expectations.

Contribute to continuous improvement of HR onboarding processes, materials, and workflow enhancements.

Qualifications

Minimum 3 years of experience in HR onboarding, training coordination, or HR operations -preferably in a BPO, staffing, or remote-first environment.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with strong empathy for new employees.

Highly organized and detail-oriented, capable of managing multiple onboarding cycles simultaneously.

Proficiency in Google Workspace, HRIS/ATS platforms, and onboarding or employee management tools.

Strong understanding of remote workforce practices and virtual communication norms.

Comfortable facilitating live sessions or presentations for groups.

Preferred Skills

Background in HR, Learning & Development, or employee training.

Familiarity with employee lifecycle processes, HR documentation, or learning management systems (LMS).

Knowledge of engagement, retention, and employee experience strategies during onboarding.

Experience developing onboarding documentation, guides, presentations, or multimedia materials.
