Pride Global

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-6230111792955479082?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=6415602175787512139&crId=US_0US_0)

### Job Description

Job Description

Our Global client in the tech industry is seeking a **Marketing Coordinator (I)**

Apply today for consideration!

**Title:  Marketing Coordinator (I)**

**Duration of the contract: 4 Months**

**Pay Range: $40/hr to $46/hr on W2**

**Location: San Francisco, CA – (Hybrid ie Monday, Friday WFH and Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday WFO)**

**Job Description:**

**Qualifications:**

- As a Marketing Coordinator, you make direct contributions under the scope of a larger project, with general guidance from the manager.
- You execute medium-scale campaigns, assets, communications, and programs to address user needs, and identify the most effective channels for reaching targeted users.
- You provide support in evaluating product and feature improvements, identify critical user journeys for future and active consumers, and develop actionable insights for marketing leadership and other partners by conducting user research and analyzing the market.
- You develop thought leadership material, client and executive narratives and presentations, case studies, and content to accelerate the business momentum to better engage our customers and agency partners.
- You apply standard tools, resources, and processes to solve defined problems, and proactively seek opportunities to find innovative solutions to improve existing processes.
- You make a direct impact on the work of the team through quality, accuracy, timeliness, and volume of work provided by self and others.
- You hold yourself and the team accountable for DEI development and outcomes, set expectations for the team, track progress through measurable results, and engage in learning and reflection.
- You foster a climate where everyone in the organization feels they belong through encouraging inclusive decision making, building psychological safety in the team, facilitating inclusive meetings, etc.

**Responsibilities include:**

- Develop framework and rollout strategies for product marketing content across channels, with some guidance.
- Identify, collect, and track defined product/business metrics, both quantitative and qualitative, for new or existing products or business ventures.
- Create space in meetings, projects, events for everyone to collaborate and feel supported. Role model, acknowledge, and empower inclusive behavior and provide constructive feedback on disrespectful, non-inclusive behavior. Act as a diversity change agent, working to change processes, culture, or other barriers to inclusion.
- Share knowledge on product(s) or feature(s) with partners across team to provide input in the product and feature development process, conduct market analysis, and predict and provide insights on industry trends on product development and marketing.
- Execute medium-scale campaigns, assets, communications, and programs to address user needs and team objectives and key results (OKRs). Evaluate and analyze campaign performance for optimization, identify channels for reaching and engaging users, and support integrated channels to meet targets.
- Develop user insights to help cross-functional teams and product partners incorporate user voice into product development and marketing strategies.
- Provide inputs to internal and external teams on improvement opportunities for user experience, manage and advocate for in-product user experience to resolve product issues, and promote user engagement.
- Help develop product brand positioning, value propositions, and messaging strategy using voice and user insights, adapt nuances of specific product voice or goals to different communications (e.g., narratives, brand framework document).
- Support development of marketing content to ensure that positioning of the product is aligned with the product strategy, iterate the content and design along with cross-functional teams based on content standards, styles, and format, and collaborate with the production team to publish the final marketing content, with oversight.
- Exercise sound judgment & take swift action to uphold our Core Values & Code of Conduct. Champion and creating psychological safety on the team for multiple perspectives to thrive, being sensitive to cultural norms, expectations, and ways of communicating.
- Actively mitigates one's own biases and flexes style to accommodate others while helping others to learn about new identities and cultures to expand their viewpoints and relationships.
- Support validation of the market size and opportunity (e.g., active users, revenue, market size, sales in units, growth. profit), under oversight.
- Help to identify opportunities in the market landscape.
- Collaborate with relevant teams to build supporting rationales, hypotheses, and visions, under guidance. Understand the product and target audience, develop the positioning of the product to users and bring the products to the market, and develop and execute the go-to-market plan and messages for new products and features.

\- Identify research needs, scope, manage, or guide user research by leveraging internal and external research partners.

### Job Description

Job Description

**Benefits:**

- 401(k)
- Employee discounts
- Health insurance
- Paid time off

We're Hiring – Bookkeeper & Office Manager **Accounting \| Office Administration \| HR Coordination**

**Company:** Light & Green

**Location:** Los Angeles, CA

**Employment:** Full-Time

About Light & Green

Light & Green is an established and growing architectural lighting company specializing in high-end, innovative plaster lighting solutions for luxury residential and commercial projects.

We are seeking an experienced, highly organized, dependable, and proactive **Bookkeeper & Office Manager** to oversee our bookkeeping, office administration, and HR coordination.

This is a hands-on position for someone who takes ownership, works independently, and helps create an organized, efficient, and accountable workplace.

Key Responsibilities

**1\. Bookkeeping & Accounting**

- Manage daily bookkeeping using QuickBooks.

- Handle Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable.

- Perform bank and credit card reconciliations.

- Process invoices, vendor payments, and expenses.

- Monitor outstanding receivables and coordinate payment follow-ups.

- Maintain accurate general ledger records.

- Prepare monthly financial reports and summaries for management.

- Coordinate with external accountants and tax professionals.

- Support inventory accounting and purchasing reconciliations.

- Assist with the transition from QuickBooks to Odoo ERP.


**2\. Office Management**

- Oversee daily office administration and organization.

- Coordinate office supplies, maintenance, equipment, and vendors.

- Maintain organized company records, contracts, and documentation.

- Support management with administrative projects and scheduling.

- Follow up on internal assignments and deadlines.

- Improve office procedures and administrative efficiency.

- Help maintain a professional and productive office environment.


**3\. Human Resources Administration**

- Coordinate employee onboarding and offboarding.

- Maintain accurate and confidential employee records.

- Track employee attendance, vacation, sick leave, and PTO.

- Coordinate payroll processing through ADP.

- Assist with employee benefits administration.

- Maintain employee documentation and company policies.

- Support recruitment, interview scheduling, and new-hire paperwork.

- Coordinate HR-related matters with management and external professionals.

- Help ensure administrative compliance with applicable employment requirements.


Qualifications

- Minimum 3–5 years of professional bookkeeping experience.

- Previous office management experience.

- Strong knowledge of QuickBooks.

- Experience with ADP payroll preferred.

- Odoo ERP experience is highly desirable.

- Strong Excel and Microsoft Office skills.

- Familiarity with California HR administration and payroll procedures.

- Excellent organizational and communication skills.

- High attention to detail and confidentiality.

- Ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities and work independently.

- Experience in manufacturing, distribution, or inventory-based businesses is a plus.


The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who:

- Takes ownership and follows through.

- Is proactive rather than waiting for instructions.

- Is highly organized and detail-oriented.

- Can identify problems and implement solutions.

- Communicates clearly and professionally.

- Enjoys working in a growing, fast-paced company.


Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications.

Apply

Please submit your resume, relevant experience, and salary expectations.

Ability to effectively prioritize tasks

Experience in event coordination or hospitality

Additional Requirements

JWCH Institute Inc

[Los Angeles, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Los-Angeles%2C-CA)

**Position Purpose:** The Administrative Coordinator is a non-management position that is a liaison that provides assistance and support to the ECM management team. The The Administrative Coordinator may also carry a limited case load and provide comprehensive case management services to all eligible patients who are high utilizers of services, individuals and families experiencing homelessness, adults with serious mental illness or substance use disorders, children and adults transitioning from incarceration.

In addition, this position will be responsible for the development, collecting, reporting and tracking encounters, quality outcome data and using health record NextGen, i2i /HEDIS measures and health plan reports. Upon request will implement and maintain ECM data and recurring reports as well as the ECM Dashboards that utilize the underlying data stores for internal and external use.

**Principal Responsibilities:**

01. Collaborate and communicate with the ECM management team, providers, managed care plans, Housing Navigation team, and community homeless service providers to ensure enhanced care coordination for eligible patients and/or entities, promoting a seamless patient experience and avoiding duplication of services.
02. Provide guidance and support to Case Managers under the direction of the ECM management team.
03. Assist with onboarding, orientation, scheduling, training, and ongoing staff education.
04. Monitor and provide feedback regarding ECM Case Managers' and Housing Navigators' daily activities, including productivity, documentation, efficiency, caseload assignment and tracking, timely completion of care plans for clinical consultant review, and other performance indicators.
05. Prepare and complete assigned reports related to productivity and performance metrics for ECM Case Managers, including collecting, tracking, and reporting encounter and outcome data from NextGen and other Behavioral Health data sources.
06. Conduct case management services, including intake and assessment, development and implementation of comprehensive care plans, monitoring patient progress, and maintaining timely documentation.
07. Connect members with subspecialty referrals, social services, support services, transportation resources, food assistance, and housing resources.
08. Maintain professionalism in conduct and appearance while advocating on behalf of members with healthcare professionals.
09. Provide health promotion and education to members to support overall wellness and care outcomes.
10. Participate in agency and community meetings focused on patient needs and case management-related issues.
11. Attend weekly case conferences with PCPs, clinical supervisors, and peers to support problem-solving, collaboration, and the delivery of high-quality case management services.
12. Adhere to all organizational safety policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements to ensure a safe environment for patients, staff, and visitors.
13. Participate in required safety and compliance trainings and apply learned practices in daily work activities.
14. Identify, report, and help mitigate unsafe conditions, incidents, or hazards in the workplace.
15. Use equipment, tools, and supplies safely and responsibly in accordance with organizational and regulatory standards.
16. Maintain awareness of infection control, occupational health, and emergency preparedness procedures appropriate to the role.
17. Participate in JWCH's customer service training called AIDET on an annual basis.

1. Demonstrate an understanding of AIDET (Acknowledge, Introduce, Duration, Explanation, and Thank You) to apply in patient encounters or team discussions.
2. Utilize the AIDET communication framework to communicate with patients and team members in a manner that reduces patient anxiety, increases patient compliance, and improves clinical outcomes.

18\. Performs other duties as assigned within scope of practice.

**Requirements:**

1. AA or bachelor's degree in Social Work, sociology or related field experience with at least 1-year experience as care coordinator, community health worker or similar responsibilities or
2. High School Diploma or GED with at least 2 years' experience as care coordinator, housing navigation, community health worker or similar responsibilities.
3. Minimun of 2 years' experience working with data in health care field with advanced knowledge with Excel and other software such as Microsoft Word
4. Trained and experienced in Nextgen Electronic Health Record system
5. Experience working with individuals who have multiple chronic conditions, ER visits or frequent in-patients' admissions or experiencing homelessness.
6. Strong desire to work as part of multi-disciplinary team with care coordinators, LCSW, MSW, PCP's and MAs.
7. Bilingual (English/Spanish) ability strongly preferred

**\*All JWCH, Wesley Health Centers workforce are recommended to be fully vaccinated and boosted against COVID-19.**

**Employee Benefits:**

At JWCH Institute, Inc., we believe in taking care of those who take care of others. If you work 30+ hours per week, you'll enjoy competitive pay and a robust benefits package that includes:

- Medical, Dental, Vision
- Monthly employer-sponsored allowance for assistance with health premiums.
- Funded Health Savings Account (up to deductible) to assist with carrier-approved medical expenses.
- Paid time off (vacation, sick leave) and 13 paid holidays.
- 401(k) Safe Harbor Profit Sharing plan.
- Mileage reimbursement.
- Short- and long-term disability plans (LTD/STD).
- Life insurance policy & AD&D, and more!

Become part of a team where your work matters. Apply today and help us change lives, one patient at a time.

### Job Description

Job Description

**Benefits:**

- Company parties
- Free food & snacks
- Free uniforms
- Opportunity for advancement

We are seeking a dynamic and highly organized Office Administrator to join our team! Construction and or restoration expereince required. In this vital role, you will be the backbone of our daily operations, ensuring that the office runs smoothly, efficiently, and professionally. Your proactive approach and excellent communication skills will help foster a welcoming environment for clients, visitors, and team members alike. This position offers an exciting opportunity to utilize your administrative expertise and technical proficiency in a fast-paced, supportive setting. If you thrive on multitasking, problem-solving, and delivering exceptional customer service, we want to hear from you!

Duties

- Manage front desk responsibilities including answering multi-line phone systems, and directing calls with professionalism and courtesy
- Handle calendar management and scheduling for meetings, appointments, and events using productivity software such as Microsoft Office and Google Workspace
- Perform data entry tasks with accuracy using spreadsheets and word processing tools; maintain organized filing systems both digitally and physically
- Assist with bookkeeping duties utilizing QuickBooks or similar accounting software to support billing, invoicing, and expense tracking
- Provide excellent customer support by addressing inquiries promptly via phone or email, ensuring client communication is clear and professional
- Support office management functions such as ordering supplies, maintaining office equipment, and overseeing general administrative tasks
- Proofread documents for accuracy and clarity while ensuring adherence to company standards; manage document version control

Requirements

- Proven experience in office administration or clerical roles with a strong background in office management and customer service
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook), Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets), and productivity software; strong computer literacy overall
- Familiarity with QuickBooks or similar bookkeeping software is highly desirable
- Excellent organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks effectively in a fast-paced environment
- Strong phone etiquette skills with experience managing multi-line phone systems; bilingual abilities are a plus for diverse client interactions
- Demonstrated ability to handle data entry accurately while maintaining attention to detail; experience in proofreading is beneficial
- Previous experience as a receptionist or personal assistant is advantageous; familiarity with contruction and resoration prefered
- Ability to manage calendars efficiently, coordinate meetings seamlessly, and support overall office operations with professionalism

Join us as an Office Administrator where your organizational talents will make a meaningful impact! We value energetic individuals who are eager to contribute their skills in a collaborative environment. This paid position offers the chance to develop your career while supporting our vibrant team every day.

- Construction and or restoration adminsistration (Required)

# Sales Operations Manager (Starlink Channel Sales)

SpaceX

[Hawthorne, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Hawthorne%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-8658133760622849722?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6506&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-8807117637309660854&crId=US_0US_0)

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.SALES OPERATIONS MANAGER (STARLINK CHANNEL SALES)Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation delivering high-speed, low-latency broadband to customers around the globe. As the Sales Operations Manager, you will own the systems, processes, and data that make our reseller channel scalable and high performing. You will operate reseller portal onboarding, co-sell registration, Know Your Customer (KYC) requirements, and pipeline reporting from the channel—then turn that information into clean systems, dashboards, and workflows that make Channel Sales, Enterprise Sales, and every member of our channel more productive. You will work closely with Channel Sales, Sales Operations, Sales Enablement, Product, Legal, Finance, Compliance, and GTM engineering to remove friction between direct and indirect motions and unlock efficient indirect revenue.RESPONIBILITIES:Own reseller portal onboarding operations, tiering workflows, portal readiness, and clean reseller data across CRM and reseller systems—so new and existing channel members can work productively without frictionDesign and operate co-sell registration as part of the tiering approval process, ensuring required information is captured completely and consistently before approvalBuild and run the quarterly channel data collection process to capture KYC and pipeline reporting from resellers; define how data is submitted, validated, stored, and used in systems and reports with Legal, Finance, Compliance, Sales Operations, and GTM engineeringPartner with Channel Sales on reseller performance by owning the data, reporting, scorecards, and operational insights that help Channel Sales manage the channel—without owning reseller performance management or running business reviewsDefine and enforce service levels for portal onboarding, co-sell registration, quarterly KYC/pipeline submissions, and handoffs across Channel Managers, Sales Operations, Legal, Finance, and ComplianceCollaborate with the GTM Engineer and Data Engineer to improve data quality, automate capture of KYC and pipeline inputs, and embed reseller-safe tooling that increases productivity for Channel Sales, Enterprise Sales, and channel membersEstablish success metrics for channel operations (portal onboarding cycle time, co-sell registration completeness, quarterly KYC/pipeline submission rate and quality, data usability in reports) and continuously optimize based on field and Channel Sales feedbackAct as a trusted advisor to channel and enterprise leadership on operational bottlenecks, data readiness, and investments that scale indirect revenue and improve productivity across the channelBASIC QUALIFICATIONS:Bachelor’s degree5+ years of experience in channel operations, reseller operations, sales operations, revenue operations, or a related go-to-market function1+ years of experience owning reseller or channel operational processes such as portal onboarding, registration workflows, PRM/portal operations, or channel data/reportingPREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:Experience supporting Enterprise or complex B2B channel/reseller motions (ideally technology, SaaS, telecom, satellite/connectivity, or hardware)Experience designing or operating registration/tiering workflows and collecting KYC or equivalent compliance information from resellersExperience building systems or processes to collect recurring channel pipeline reporting and turn it into usable CRM data, dashboards, and operational insights for sales leadershipStrong CRM discipline (HubSpot or Salesforce) and experience operating reseller portals or PRM platformsData-driven mindset with ability to define and track channel ops KPIs (portal onboarding cycle time, registration completeness, quarterly submission rates, data quality, productivity impact)Excellent communication skills with the ability to document processes, train Channel Managers and resellers on portal/registration/data requirements, and drive cross-functional alignment without formal authorityExperience working in high-growth, fast-paced environments with frequent product, pricing, and process changesFamiliarity with co-sell motions, channel conflict resolution, and compliance workflows is a plusADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:Available to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed to support major product launches, reseller programs, certification events, or critical sales initiativesWillingness to travel as needed to support channel manager training, reseller enablement, and key eventsCOMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:
**Pay Range:**
Level 3: $110,000.00 - $150,000.00Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. **Position: Scheduler**

**Salary Range: $133,000 - $139,000**

**Location:** Onsite (Los Angeles, CA)

**Type:** Full-Time

Public Works, Rebuild Authority, is seeking one (1) experienced **Scheduler II or III** to develop, maintain, and report on schedules for a portfolio of recovery and rebuild capital projects. The anticipated rough order magnitude value of the collective projects is approximately $800 million.

Candidates are required to have at least 5 years of experience in planning and scheduling public works or construction projects from design through construction and close-out.

Candidates are **required** to possess the following:

01. Minimum 10 years (Scheduler II) or 15 years (Scheduler III) of project scheduling experience on public capital or construction projects.
02. Advanced proficiency in scheduling software, inclusive of Primavera and Microsoft Project.
03. Education background in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Architecture, or related field.
04. Ability to develop critical path method (CPM) baseline schedules and maintain them through regular updates.
05. Ability to build and maintain an integrated master program schedule across multiple concurrent projects.
06. Skilled in reviewing contractor baseline schedules, monthly updates, and recovery schedules for compliance with contract requirements; incorporation of other schedule impact factors, such as community meetings, partner agency concurrent work, and funding sources.
07. Ability to prepare and evaluate time impact analyses and delay claims.
08. Ability to perform resource loading and cost loading, and to support earned value reporting.
09. Ability to produce clear schedule narratives, look-ahead schedules, milestone reports, and executive-level summaries
10. Effective oral and written communication skills, including presenting schedule status to management.
11. Ability to coordinate with project managers, design consultants, contractors, and partner agencies to identify schedule risks and mitigation options.
12. Ability to adapt and respond effectively to changing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**Preferred:**

- Experience with disaster recovery or post-disaster rebuild programs.
